title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines-based VAs only)



Read this whole thing before you apply. If you skim it, you'll fail step one.



Smartland manages 1,400+ rental homes and apartments. The CEO moves fast and d
 faster. This role exists to make him faster still: to remove friction, anticipate the next three steps, and never let a ball drop. You are his memory, his logic check, and his second brain.





This is not a calendar-and-coffee job. If that's what you're looking for, stop here.



What you'll actually do:



Run the CEO's day so he doesn't have to think about logistics: calendar, travel, prep, follow-through.

Catch things before they become problems. We expect you to flag what we missed.

Hold the full picture in your head: who owes what, what's due when, which thread is still open.

Turn vague direction into a finished result without being walked through it.

Build and maintain checklists for everything, because nothing falls through a good checklist.



Who we're looking for:



You think fast and you think clearly. Sloppy logic is a dealbreaker.

Your memory is sharp. People are surprised by what you remember.

You are relentlessly organized. You love checklists, genuinely, not as a line on a résumé.

You're proactive. You'd rather ask forgiveness than wait for instructions on the obvious.

You think strategically. You see why a task matters, not just what the task is.

When the standard template doesn't fit, you build a better one.



Do not apply if:



You need detailed instructions to start.

You've ever said "that's not my job."

You drop tasks and blame the volume.

You're hoping to wing it. We will find out by week one.



English Communication Requirement



Candidates must have strong English communication skills, with a minimum expected level of B2; C1 is preferred.



You should be able to communicate clearly and professionally in both written and spoken English, understand instructions accurately, and communicate effectively with clients, prospects, and internal team members.



An English proficiency test result is not required at the time of application. However, Smartland may request proof of English proficiency later in the hiring process, including after the interview, if needed.



English proficiency will be evaluated throughout the screening and interview process.



Please do not apply if you do not feel confident communicating professionally in English at a B2 level or higher.

title: Creative Strategist – Meta Ads | E-commerce
description:
Creative Strategist

E-commerce · Meta Ads · Dropshipping & Branded Funnels

Part-time ? Full-time | NO · DE · CA · IL



About Us



If you've built winning Meta creatives for European e-commerce markets and you're tired of working with teams that don't move fast — this is for you.



We run a fast-growing e-commerce group with multiple dropshipping and branded funnels across Norway, Germany, Sweden, and Israel. Our products span health supplements, gadgets, and home goods — and we scale aggressively through paid Meta ads, high-volume creative testing, and data-driven decision making.



Our team includes media buyers, funnel builders, video editors, and customer support. We manage significant monthly ad spend across five active storefronts. Now we're hiring a Creative Strategist to own and systemise everything related to ad creatives.



The Role



You own the strategy behind all paid ad creatives. You don't edit videos or launch ads. Your job is to d
 what gets made, which angles get tested, why something wins or loses, and how winners are iterated and scaled.



You will work directly with the CEO, media buyers, and video editors with one goal: lower CPA and unlock scale.



What You'll Do

- Develop creative angles and concepts for Meta ads across multiple funnels and markets.

- Write clear, detailed creative briefs for video editors and UGC creators.

- Translate ad performance data (hook rate, CTR, CVR, ROAS, CPA) into actionable creative decisions.

- Define weekly creative testing priorities and iteration roadmaps.

- Analyse hooks, retention, watch time, scroll-stop rate, and creative fatigue.

- D
 when to iterate, kill, or scale creatives — and explain why.

- Ensure strong alignment between ads and landing pages across markets.

- Manage multi-market creative output — including copy adapted for NO, DE, SE, and IL audiences.

- Collaborate with media buyers to improve CPA stability and scalability.

- Maintain structured creative documentation and testing learnings.



What You Bring

- 2+ years of hands-on experience with performance creatives for Meta 
/Instagram) ads in e-commerce.

- Strong direct response mindset — you care about results, not aesthetics.

- Deep understanding of hooks, angles, retention curves, and creative testing frameworks.

- Ability to read ad performance data and turn it into clear, fast creative direction.

- Experience briefing and managing video editors or UGC creators.

- Fluent written and spoken English. Additional languages (Norwegian, German, Hebrew) are a plus.

- High attention to detail and a structured, systematic way of thinking.

- Ownership mentality — you spot problems early and act without hand-holding.

- Comfortable working with performance reports and creative trackers.



Experience with health/supplement creatives and Meta compliance is a strong advantage.



How We Work — and What You Get

- Part-time start with a clear path to full-time for top performers.

- $6–$10/hour depending on experience, with performance bonuses on top.

- Merit-based raises as your impact on ROAS and CPA becomes measurable.

- Direct collaboration with the CEO and media buyers — no layers, fast feedback.

- Access to proven funnels, live ad accounts, SOPs, and real ad spend from day one.

- Long-term growth into Head of Creative or broader strategy roles.

- Approved expense reimbursement where applicable.



Our Selection Process



We take hiring seriously. A short skills assessment is part of our process — you'll be asked to analyse real ad data, develop creative angles, and write copy for actual products we run. It's designed to take around 2–3 hours and reflects the real work of this role.



How to Apply



Put your favourite animal in the subject line. This helps us spot detail-oriented applicants.



Please include:

- Your CV or resume

- Examples of creatives or brands you've worked on (screenshots or Looms are fine)

- A short paragraph on how you approach creative testing and iteration

- Your weekly availability

- Your approximate hourly rate expectation



Do not use AI to write your application. We test this during the assessment and will disqualify candidates who do.



We look forward to seeing what you've built.

Virtual Assistant — Remote (Full-Time)



Company: Majestix Collection Location: Remote (Philippines-based preferred)



We're a growing pre-owned luxury watch company looking for a Virtual Assistant who doesn't just follow instructions — but follows them well, takes ownership of their work, and genuinely wants to get better at what they do every single day.



What You'll Be Doing



You will support the team with day-to-day tasks across multiple functions, help improve how things get done, and learn new tools and skills as the company scales. Some days you'll be managing listings. Other days you'll be drafting SOPs, editing content, or troubleshooting a workflow. No two weeks look the same, and that's the point.



This is a remote role with long-term growth potential for the right person.



Qualifications

Exceptional attention to detail and strong organizational skills

Proficiency in data management, including advanced skills in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets

Eager to learn and adapt to new tools, strategies, and responsibilities

title: Experienced SMM and Video Editor 4-5+ years experience
description:
JSK Advisory is a fast-growing marketing and automation agency helping professional service firms, eCommerce brands, and local service businesses scale using modern marketing systems. We are a startup but growing fast and are looking for an experienced and proactive person to join our social media and creative editing team. This is a fantastic opportunity to work with national brands across ecommerce and professional services and the right person will have long term career development opportunites. We're also based in Sydney Australia with only a 3 hour timezone difference from the Philippines, allowing you to work daytime hours (no graveyard shift!).



This role is focused on creating high-quality short-form content and ad creatives for
 and Instagram across our agency account, eCommerce brand and professional service clients. You will edit raw footage and voiceovers into polished videos, develop strong hooks for organic and paid content, add captions, on-screen text, graphics, and transitions, and ensure consistent visual quality and branding across all accounts. You must have experience using Higgs field and VEED all platforms that can generate similar output. Especially
 ad videos that look professional and use professional captioning.



As JSK Advisory continues to grow, this role offers clear long-term career pathways into
 Ads management and senior creative or account management positions. Salary is $1000-$1500pm based on experience and skills.



To apply, please provide your cover letter, resume, portfolio, Words Per Minute typing speed (
/student/tests). Also include a one-minute video introducing yourself, outlining your experience, and explaining why you would be a good fit for the role. You must include the videos you have edited in the past.

title: Amazon Account Manager / Operations Manager
description:
Are you a strategic, data-driven brand builder with a passion for Amazon?

We are a fast-growing Amazon private label brand looking for a full-time Amazon Account Manager to take ownership of our product development pipeline, listing optimization, and brand positioning.



You’ll play a key leadership role in launching products, optimizing conversion rates, and developing a strong, consistent brand presence. This is a long-term opportunity with potential for growth in a collaborative, performance-driven environment.



Key Responsibilities

-Accountability & Ownership

-Lead and maintain a robust product development pipeline (from idea to launch)

-Optimize product listings for maximum visibility and conversions

-Manage all branding, positioning, and messaging efforts

-Implement CRO strategies and run continuous A/B tests

-Coordinate freelancers (designers, photographers, content creators)

-Monitor and improve brand health metrics: rankings, reviews, CTR, CR, etc.



Daily & Weekly Tasks

-Research product trends and discover new product ideas

-Analyze competitors for differentiation and CRO opportunities

-Track performance: sessions, conversion rates, sales rank

-Collaborate with supply chain, PPC, and creative teams to align launch and inventory strategies



Long-Term Projects & Goals

-Build a consistent and strategic brand identity across all customer touchpoints

-Establish a repeatable, scalable system for product launches

-Increase customer loyalty and retention through compelling branding and messaging



 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Objective: Develop and maintain a validated pipeline of launch-ready products

Metrics: 

-Number of product ideas researched and validated monthly

-Number of products launched per quarter

-First 90-day sales & review performance



Actions:

-Run research & validation using Helium 10 and market analysis

-Coordinate with suppliers, creatives, and PPC

-Maintain and update Product Pipeline Tracker



KPI 2: Conversion Rate Optimization

Metric: Conversion Rate (%) from Amazon Business Reports

-Optimize listings, copy, and A+ content

-Improve visuals and run split tests

-Monitor and iterate based on data and performance feedback



 Qualifications & Skills

Required:

-3+ years of experience managing private label brands on Amazon

-Proven success with multiple product launches

-Deep understanding of Amazon SEO and the Amazon algorithm

-Expertise in Helium 10, keyword research, and listing optimization

-Skilled in briefing and coordinating designers and content teams

-Familiarity with A+ content, storefront management, and conversion tracking

-Background in marketing, branding, or e-commerce growth strategy

-Knowledge of CRO tools and testing platforms (e.g., ManageByStats, Splitly)

-Experience using tools like Asana, Notion, or Trello for project management

-Awareness of PPC’s influence on organic ranking



 Soft Skills:

-High attention to detail and ownership mentality

-Strong marketing sense and customer-centric thinking

-Excellent written and verbal English communication

-Organized, self-driven, and proactive

-Analytical mindset – able to turn data into decisions



 What We Offer

-Competitive rates

-Fully remote, flexible working hours

-Bi-weekly payments and performance reviews

-Long-term role with growth potential

-Paid leave and additional benefits after 6 months (SSS, Pag-ibig, health insurance)

-Supportive team culture with room for innovation and contribution

4. Complete the internet speed test from speedtest.net and attach a screenshot

This is more than just a brand management job. It’s an opportunity to lead, build, and scale something meaningful. If you’re driven by impact, autonomy, and a clear path to success, we’d love to meet you.

Monitor behavior signals (CTR, CVR, returns, reviews) and iterate

Return rate trends and top return reasons

Q&A hygiene and listing clarity improvements

Review monitoring + recurring issue reporting

Strengthen product education via visuals + A+ modules

Required

3+ years managing private label brands on Amazon (account management / listing optimization

Deep understanding of Amazon SEO and algorithm fundamentals

Strong experience with Helium 10, keyword research, and listing optimization

Proven ability to brief and coordinate creatives (designers, copywriters, photographers)

Familiarity with A+ content, storefront management, and conversion tracking

Strong operational discipline: can manage tasks, trackers, and deadlines without hand-holding



Preferred

Background in marketing, branding, or e-commerce growth strategy

Experience with CRO/testing platforms (e.g., ManageByStats, Splitly, Amazon Experiments)

Experience using Asana, Notion, or Trello for project management

Understanding of PPC’s relationship to CTR/CVR and organic rank (coordination-level, not necessarily hands-on media buying)



Soft Skills

Ownership mentality and high attention to detail

Strong marketing instincts and customer-centric thinking

Excellent written and verbal English communication

Organized, proactive, and reliable

Analytical mindset — able to turn data into decisions



What We Offer

Competitive rates

Fully remote

Bi-weekly payments and performance reviews

Long-term role with growth potential

Paid leave and additional benefits after 6 months (SSS, Pag-ibig, health insurance)

Supportive team culture with room for innovation and contribution

Training resources and personal development opportunities



How to Apply

Include in subject line: “[Your Favorite Book] - Amazon Account / Brand Manager Application”

Attach your updated resume

Include a short video (2–3 min) introducing yourself and describing your:

Experience optimizing Amazon listings and improving conversion rates

Tools you’ve used and how you used them

A specific listing improvement you made and the result (CTR/CVR/rank/reviews)

Complete the internet speed test from speedtest.net and attach a screenshot

Attach a screenshot with your computer specs



Why Join Us?

This is more than just account management. It’s an opportunity to take ownership of Amazon performance, strengthen a real brand, and build systems that scale. If you’re driven by impact, autonomy, and measurable outcomes, we’d love to meet you.

title: KOL Outreach Manager
description:
About BabyDoge



BabyDoge is one of the most recognized brands in the Web3 space, originally launched as a community-driven 
coin. Today, we are building a utility-driven ecosystem designed to entertain, reward, and empower our global audience.



The BabyDoge Ecosystem includes:



-BabyDoge Coin — a hyper-deflationary cryptocurrency with rewards for holders


 Mini-Apps — including Paws by BabyDoge, a gamified platform where users earn, compete, and climb leaderboards

-RWA Platform — enabling users to purchase real-world real estate in Dubai through blockchain technology

-DeFi Solutions — expanding financial freedom with accessible, decentralized products

-Charity Initiatives — supporting animal welfare organizations globally



Our mission is clear: bringing crypto to the masses while saving dogs. We believe blockchain should be simple, impactful, and accessible to everyone.

We are seeking candidates who share our values and can help expand our global reach by building strong partnerships with key opinion leaders (KOLs).





Role Overview



The KOL Outreach Manager will be responsible for identifying, engaging, and managing relationships with influencers, content creators, and key opinion leaders across various markets. This role is essential to expanding BabyDoge’s visibility and fostering trusted partnerships within the Web3, crypto, and broader digital communities.



Key Responsibilities:



-Research, identify, and prioritize KOLs, influencers, and creators aligned with BabyDoge’s brand and values

-Conduct outreach, build relationships, and manage negotiations with KOLs for promotional activities

-Coordinate and track influencer campaigns across platforms, ensuring alignment with marketing objectives

-Maintain a structured database of partnerships, campaign performance, and communications

-Collaborate with internal teams to align messaging and ensure consistent brand representation

-Provide regular reports on campaign outcomes, performance metrics, and partnership development

-Monitor trends within influencer marketing and the crypto industry to optimize outreach strategy



Skills and Qualifications



-Proven experience in influencer marketing, outreach management, or partnership development, preferably within the gaming, tech, charity or Web 3 sectors.

-Fluent English, with a minimum proficiency level of C1

-Native-level proficiency in at least one of the following languages is a significant advantage: Spanish, Portuguese, Russian

-Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills

-Understanding of social media platforms, influencer ecosystems, and crypto communities

-Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and relationships simultaneously

-Results-driven mindset with strong analytical and reporting capabilities

-Familiarity with Web3 culture, terminology, and market trends (preferred but not required)



What We Offer



-Fully remote working environment

-Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives

-Opportunity to expand a global influencer network within the Web3 space

-Collaborative, mission-driven team culture

-Direct contribution to the growth and visibility of one of the most recognized brands in crypto



Why This Role Matters



As KOL Outreach Manager, you will play a critical role in amplifying BabyDoge’s global presence. By fostering strategic partnerships with influencers and opinion leaders, you will directly contribute to expanding our community, increasing brand awareness, and advancing our mission to bring crypto to the masses while supporting dog welfare initiatives worldwide. is a 
 token and ecosystem of Web3 products empowering a growing global community on their path to financial freedom while remaining playful and fun. Our mission is clear: bringing crypto to the masses while saving dogs. We believe blockchain should be simple, impactful, and accessible to everyone.

We are seeking candidates who share our values and can help expand our global reach by building strong partnerships with key opinion leaders (KOLs).

Go through this list honestly. If any one is a "no," please don't apply — you won't pass the screening, and we don't want to waste your time.



☐ 1. English — written. You can write a reply to a US customer that needs zero editing. Correct grammar, natural tone, no Taglish, no AI. Your form answers will be judged exactly as written.



☐ 2. English — spoken and accent. You can talk on Zoom with a US business owner, camera on, and they understand you easily the first time. Neutral or light accent is fine. Heavy accent, reading from a script, or long pauses to find words is not. You must be able to follow fast, casual American speech.



☐ 3. GoHighLevel — hands-on. You have personally worked inside GoHighLevel for at least 1 year. Not watched videos — built things. Sub-accounts, contacts, custom fields, tags, pipelines, the Conversations tab.



☐ 4. Workflows — texting. You have built SMS/text workflows in the GHL workflow builder yourself: trigger → wait → send SMS → if/else → tag → next step. You can explain why each step is there.



☐ 5. Workflows — debugging with Execution Logs. You know where the Execution Logs are on a workflow, you've opened them for a real contact, and you can read them to answer "did the message actually send, and if not, where did it stop?" If you've never opened Execution Logs, this is a no.



☐ 6. US Eastern night shift. You have worked 9 PM – 6 AM Philippine time before, for a US employer, for months — not days. You know you can sustain it. Tell us where and for how long.



If all 6 are "yes," keep reading.



What the job is



Three parts. Roughly half your shift on support, a third on setup, and one protected day a week making videos.



Part 1 — Support (answer customers)



You are the first reply on every support ticket,
, and Slack message. Reply within 1 hour, every time.

Answer "how do I" questions about Tuco inside GoHighLevel.

When a customer says "my contact is in the workflow but nothing shows in Conversations," you open the Execution Logs and the Tuco logs, find out what actually happened, and tell them. No guessing.

If it's a real bug, write a clean ticket for our engineer: steps, contact ID, screenshots, timestamps.



Part 2 — Setup (install Tuco for new customers)



Follow our checklist: install Tuco in the customer's GHL sub-account, connect the line, build their first text workflow, test it with a real contact, confirm the message sent.

Build one clean "reference workflow" the customer can copy to other accounts.

Run short (20–30 minute) onboarding calls on Zoom from a script. You'll shadow the founder first.

Big integration calls (HubSpot, Pipedrive) go to a separate specialist — you just schedule them.



Part 3 — Videos (so we need fewer calls)



Record short screen-recorded tutorials (3–8 minutes) for our YouTube channel and help center. Your voice, your screen.

Rule: any question that comes up on two calls becomes a video.

Publish 1–2 videos a week with a title, description, and a matching help article. Link them in support replies instead of booking a call.

Basic editing only: trim, cut, captions. Loom, Descript, ScreenPal, or CapCut.





Also needed

Customer support experience for a software product or agency clients, in English, with US customers

Comfortable recording your voice explaining software on screen

Fiber internet (25 Mbps+), backup for brownouts, quiet room, webcam, USB or headset mic

Nice to have (not required)

GoHighLevel Certified Admin

Tutorial videos you've already made (link them)

Zapier / Make

Crisp, Intercom, or Zendesk

Worked at an agency managing client sub-accounts





This job is NOT



A general VA job — no calendar, no admin, no social media

Copywriting — customers bring their own text

Sales — no quotas, no cold calls

Why take it

Direct with the founder, online the same hours as you

Stable US company, paid on time every month

You build the support function from scratch — no existing team to fit into

Grows into Head of Customer Success as we grow





How to apply



 me at 
 



1. One Loom video, 3–5 minutes. Camera on, screen shared, no script. This one video tests checkpoints 2, 3, 4 and 5 at once.



Open any SMS/text workflow in any GoHighLevel account (yours, a client's with names hidden, or a trial sub-account you build).

Walk through it step by step: the trigger, each action, each branch, and why it's built that way.

Open that workflow's Execution Logs. Pick one contact's run. Explain what the log shows: where the contact entered, which steps fired, where it waited or stopped, and how you'd use it to answer "did the text actually send?"

Finish by answering this customer out loud, like you're on a call with them: "I've got clients stacking up and your tool is just sitting there because I don't get the workflow builder. I need one hour to get this dialed in. Can you do that?"



2. Written answer (your own words, no AI — tests checkpoint 1). A customer says their contact entered the workflow and should have gotten a text, but nothing shows in the GHL Conversations tab. List, in order, the first 5 things you would check.



3. Night-shift history (checkpoint 6): employer, hours, and dates.



4. Internet speed test screenshot.



5. Expected monthly salary in USD.



6. Optional: link to any GoHighLevel tutorial video you've already made.



7. Type the word "snapshot" in the last box so we know you read this whole post.



What happens next



Within 5 days: we reply to everyone who sent the Loom and the keyword.

About 5 people: a paid 2-hour test inside a sandbox GHL account with Tuco installed — one broken workflow to find and fix, plus a 3-minute Loom explaining the fix to the customer. Paid at your hourly rate.

Final: 30-minute video call with the founder → offer. About 10 days start to finish.



No Loom or no keyword = not reviewed.

title: Media Buyer & Conversion Specialist (Google Ads + Meta) | NZ Agency
description:
We're a small marketing agency in New Zealand. We do marketing for financial advisers, mostly mortgage and insurance advisers and KiwiSaver specialists. We're looking for someone to help run the ad accounts (with our overseeing) so we can focus on growing the business).



*What you'd actually be doing*



Taking over the day to day of our client accounts across Meta, Google and Bing.



We set the strategy and the budgets, and we sign off anything significant. Past that, the accounts are yours. You decide what runs, what gets paused, where the money moves, and which keywords are wasting it.



The other half of the job is what happens after the click. Our funnels and landing pages are built in GoHighLevel, and you'd be reviewing and improving them. Form flow, drop-off, question order, layout, load speed. There's not much point winning the auction if the page loses the lead.



Please read this bit before applying:

Nearly half of what we manage is search rather than social, and search is where we need you strongest.



We see a lot of applications from Meta specialists who have picked up a bit of Google along the way. There's nothing wrong with that, but it isn't this job. If your search experience is "I've run some campaigns", please save us both the time. We do test this properly, and there's no clever way to talk your way around a search terms report.



*What we need*

- 3+ years running paid campaigns with real budgets. Agency-side ideally, since you'd be moving between clients here

- Real Meta Ads Manager experience and real Google Ads search experience. Both of them, not one and a bit of the other

Lead generation rather than ecommerce. We're not selling products, we're getting people to pick up the phone, and the levers are different

- GoHighLevel, or another CRM and funnel builder you picked up quickly

- Good written English. You'll be documenting every change you make and you'll be in our Slack every day

- Online 7am to 11am Manila time. We're based in New Zealand and need to be able to communicate during business hours.

Nice to have but not required: financial services, mortgage or insurance advertising. GA4 and Tag Manager. Any landing page testing background. Meta or Google certifications.



*What we're like to work for*

Our clients are licensed financial advisers, which means there are real legal rules about what their ads can say. So anything a consumer will read, ad copy, headlines, anything mentioning rates, comes to us first. Everything else you just get on with.



Every change gets logged with the date and the reason you made it. That's the one thing we're strict about. It's how we stay out of your way without losing track of what's happening.



If something breaks or a cost per lead jumps, tell us the same day. Nobody here gets in trouble for bad news arriving early.



You'll always know what you're aiming for, because every client has a target cost per lead written down.



This is part-time and long-term, a direct contract with us. No agency in the middle taking a cut. Paid every fortnight through Wise on the 15th and the 30th. We've never paid anyone late and we don't intend to start with you.



*How to apply*

Please don't send a template. We read every application and we can spot one from the first line.

Tell us about an account you took over that wasn't working. What was wrong with it, what you did, what happened to the numbers afterwards. Under 250 words, and use real numbers rather than "improved significantly"

Tell us honestly whether you're stronger on Meta or on Google search, and why.

Your CV or profile, any certifications, and the hourly rate you're looking for in USD

Start your message with the word ORCHARD so we know you got this far



If you're shortlisted we'll send you a real account to look at. It takes about 90 minutes and we pay you your rate for it, because your time is worth something before you work here as well as after.



Then a video call. We're hoping to have someone chosen by mid September.



Looking forward to hearing from you!

title: Supply Chain Manager for a Multi-Brand DTC E-commerce Portfolio (Amazon + Shopify)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are a group of direct-to-consumer ecommerce brands selling physical

products (kits, apparel and accessories, supplements) across Shopify

and Amazon US. Products are manufactured in China and the US and distributed through

warehouses in China, the US and Europe.

Supply chain is currently being handled internally alongside other work,

and it has become the bottleneck. This hire takes it over. Within 60 days

you should own supplier communication, inventory planning and warehouse

planning completely.

This is not a coordinator or data-entry role. You make decisions and you

are judged on results.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

1. INVENTORY FORECASTING AND REPLENISHMENT

   Across every brand and channel (Shopify plus Amazon FBA and AWD).

   No stockouts on winners, no cash locked in dead stock.

2. CHINA FACTORY SOURCING AND NEGOTIATION

   You inherit our existing factory relationships, nurture them, run

   sample rounds, and hunt better suppliers on price, quality and lead

   time.

3. PACKAGING AND PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

   Write briefs for our in-house designers (boxes, inserts, kits,

   bundles), manage dielines and print specs with factories, approve

   samples.

4. AMAZON PLANNING

   Shipment plans, carton and prep compliance, kit and bundle size rules,

   AWD to FBA replenishment, and resolving Seller Central or warehouse

   restrictions before they cost us money.

5. INTERNATIONAL WAREHOUSE PLANNING

   3PL contracts, capacity and stock allocation across China, the US and

   Europe. Freight forwarding (ocean and air), customs paperwork, landed

   cost tracking.

6. COST REDUCTION

   Unit cost, packaging cost, freight, storage and fulfilment fees. You

   are measured on landed cost per unit and on cash tied up in inventory.

7. PRODUCT LIFECYCLE

   Flag slow movers, plan run-outs, roll them into bundles or mystery

   boxes, keep the catalog clean.

REQUIREMENTS

- 5+ years in ecommerce or DTC supply chain, procurement or logistics.

  Multi-brand or portfolio experience is a strong plus.

- Proven China factory sourcing and negotiation. You have personally

  negotiated unit prices, MOQs and lead times, and won.

- Hands-on Amazon FBA experience: shipment plans, prep and labeling

  requirements, AWD, and dealing with Seller Central restrictions.

- Freight and import knowledge: ocean and air freight, incoterms, customs

  documents, landed cost.

- Strong inventory forecasting. You build and maintain your own models in

  Google Sheets or Excel: sales velocity, lead time, safety stock,

  reorder points.

- Shopify inventory management.

- Excellent written and spoken English. You will be on calls with Chinese

  factories, US warehouses and European suppliers.

- Deadline discipline. We run on Asana. Tasks are not delivered late. If

  something will slip, you flag it BEFORE the due date, not after.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience at an 8 or 9 figure ecommerce brand.

- Packaging design or print production background.

- Setting up a new 3PL or warehouse from scratch.

- Supplement or regulated product experience.

WHAT WE OFFER

- 2800 USD per month, long term, full time.

- Real ownership. You are the decision maker on supply chain, not a

  middleman passing messages.

- Direct access to the decision makers. No layers, no politics.

- Growth. As the group adds brands, this role grows into Head of Supply

  Chain.

HOW TO APPLY

Generic applications are deleted. Answer all six points or do not apply.

1. Put the word ORANGE at the very top of your message so we know you

   read this post.

2. A supplier negotiation you personally ran. Give the product, the

   starting price, the final price, and exactly how you got there.

3. How you d
 reorder quantity and timing for a SKU. Walk us through

   the actual numbers you look at.

4. One time inventory or a shipment went wrong on your watch. What

   happened, and what you changed so it did not happen again.

5. Your Amazon FBA experience in three lines: what you shipped, how

   often, what problems you solved.

6. Your available working hours in GMT+2.

title: Short-Form Content Creator - TikTok / Reels / Shorts | Plix.GG
description:
Plix.gg is a browser gaming platform with 72,000+ games and 300K+ monthly visitors.



We're looking for a creator who genuinely understands TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, what people are watching, what formats are trending, what sounds are being used and how to turn an idea into a video people actually want to finish.



This is NOT an editing-only role.



You will research trends, find ideas, choose games, record gameplay or real-world footage and edit finished short-form videos.



We handle uploading and posting. You do not need to manage our social accounts.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who actively uses TikTok, Reels and Shorts and pays attention to:



• Current content trends and formats

• Trending music and sounds

• Hooks that stop people scrolling

• Editing styles that are working right now

• Gaming and internet culture

• What other gaming creators are doing

• Why some videos perform and others don't





You should actively research what is currently working and develop concepts independently.

Most importantly, you need good creative judgment.

Not every browser game is interesting enough to carry a video by itself.

Sometimes gameplay is enough.

Sometimes the stronger video is built around a gaming setup, laptop, phone, IRL situation, meme, challenge, POV, trend or relatable idea.



→ Your job is to know the difference.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ CONTENT CAN INCLUDE



• Single-game videos

• Multi-game videos and lists

• Gameplay

• Challenges

• Memes

• POVs

• Gaming setup / desk setup videos

• Laptop, monitor and phone footage

• Gaming room / RGB setup footage

• IRL videos filmed at home, schools, cafés, malls, outdoors, etc.

• Voiceover or no voiceover

• Trend-based concepts

• Videos built around a joke, situation or trend instead of only gameplay



If you have a good-looking gaming setup, desk, room, laptop or another visually interesting environment, we want you to use it.



For example:



→ Open with a good-looking gaming setup

→ Hook: "3 browser games I play when I'm bored"

→ Transition into the games



We want variety.



We do NOT want the same template repeated every day. But we can try good templates that did not work more times.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ WHAT YOU DO



• Research TikTok, Reels and Shorts for trends, formats, sounds and ideas

• Follow gaming creators and relevant competitors

• Find games on Plix.gg worth making content about

• Develop your own concepts and hooks

• D
 whether a video should be gameplay, IRL, setup-based, meme, POV, challenge, list, trend or another format

• Record clean gameplay

• Film attractive real-world or gaming-setup footage when needed

• Edit 10–40 second short-form videos

• Choose suitable music, trending sounds and SFX

• Add captions and on-screen text

• Test different opening hooks

• Use performance feedback from previous videos to improve future concepts



You do not need to show your face or use your own voice.



You can if you want to, but it is not required.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ OUTPUT



5–7 finished videos per week.

Videos can vary significantly in format and production effort.

Some can be simple gameplay videos.

Others may use several games, IRL footage, gaming setups, multiple locations or more complicated concepts.

We care about retention, creativity and views, not forcing every video into the same structure.

We handle publishing.



Your responsibility is delivering finished videos ready to post.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ YOU SHOULD HAVE



• Strong understanding of TikTok, Reels and Shorts

• Strong short-form editing skills

• Good instinct for hooks and first 1–3 second retention

• Awareness of current trends, sounds, formats and editing styles

• Genuine interest in games and internet culture

• Ability to develop ideas independently

• Ability to research what is currently performing

• Ability to film good-looking real-world or gaming-setup footage

• Good sense of pacing, music, captions, SFX and visual composition



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ EQUIPMENT



You need:



• PC or laptop capable of smoothly recording browser games

• Smartphone with a good camera

• Reliable internet

• CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut or similar



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ HOURS



• No fixed schedule

• No required timezone overlap

• No time tracking



Work whenever you want as long as the content is delivered on time.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ PAY



₱65,000 / month



Paid monthly via Wise.



Reasonable pre-approved expenses for outside shoots are reimbursed separately.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ HOW TO APPLY



Send the following:



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ 1 — YOUR WORK



Send 1–3 short-form videos you worked on.



For each video, tell us what you were responsible for:



• Concept

• Filming

• Hook / script

• Editing



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ 2 — YOUR SETUP



Send:



• Editing software

• PC / laptop specs

• Phone model



If you have a gaming setup, desk, room or another environment that could be used in videos, send a photo or short clip as well.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ 3 — TWO VIDEO IDEAS FOR PLIX.GG



IDEA 1 — GAMEPLAY



One gameplay-focused concept. Name the specific game and paste its plix.gg URL.



IDEA 2 — IRL / GAMING SETUP



Concept using IRL footage, a gaming setup, laptop, phone, desk, room or another visually interesting environment.



For both ideas, explain:



• What happens in the first few seconds

• The main concept

• Why you think someone would keep watching



Do not just write:



"Show gameplay with text."



We want to understand how you think about hooks and short-form content.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ 4 — SHOW US THAT YOU UNDERSTAND CURRENT TIKTOK



Send us ONE current:



• TikTok / Reels / Shorts trend

• Format

• Sound

• Editing style

• Hook style



Send the link to it, not just a description. Then explain how you would adapt it for Plix.gg.



We specifically want someone who actively researches what is working NOW rather than using the same editing style repeatedly.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ EXAMPLES



These are simple examples of content and formats that can work:

We want you to research TikTok yourself and find new formats, trends, hooks and ideas that could work better.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ PAID TRIAL



Shortlisted applicants receive a paid ₱2000 trial.

Job Description

title: Senior DaVinci Resolve Studio 21 Documentary Editor / Finishing Artist
description:
I am looking for a highly experienced DaVinci Resolve Studio 21 editor and finishing artist to give a substantially completed long-form historical documentary its final creative and technical polish before publication.



The film is a faceless documentary centred on Cornelius Vanderbilt, the Gilded Age and the rise of an American fortune. It is approximately one hour long.



The narration, story structure, music, media and main edit are already in place. I will complete my remaining manual timing corrections before handing over the project. This is not a start-from-scratch edit.



The film has a strong narrative foundation, but it now needs an expert artistic eye to make it feel richer, more cinematic, atmospheric and visually engaging. I need someone who can recognise sections that feel static, repetitive or overly reliant on basic imagery—and improve them without changing the documentary’s identity or over-editing it.



CREATIVE DIRECTION



The established visual style is “The Gilded Ledger”: an elegant, cinematic Gilded Age aesthetic using:



• Deep black and charcoal backgrounds

• Antique gold and warm ivory typography

• Archival photographs and historical footage

• Newspapers, maps, documents and financial ledgers

• Subtle film texture, depth, shadow and restrained movement

• Sophisticated chapter cards and period-inspired graphics

• A dramatic but intelligent sense of wealth, power and history



The finished film should feel like a premium historical documentary rather than a generic YouTube compilation.



I do not want excessive transitions, constant zooming, distracting effects, template-heavy editing or fast TikTok-style pacing. Every creative choice should support the narration, atmosphere and story.



THE WORK WILL INCLUDE



• Watching and assessing the complete documentary

• Identifying visually weak, repetitive or slow sections

• Improving visual pacing and continuity while protecting the narration

• Replacing or strengthening unsuitable B-roll where necessary

• Adding tasteful movement to archival images using masking, depth, parallax and controlled camera animation

• Refining typography, title cards and chapter sequences

• Creating appropriate Fusion graphics for maps, dates, documents, timelines and historical information

• Using DaVinci Resolve Studio features creatively where they genuinely improve the film

• Improving transitions between scenes and chapters

• Creating a consistent cinematic colour treatment

• Correcting differences between archival sources

• Refining sound design and completing a professional Fairlight mix of narration, music and effects

• Checking the final film for technical or visual problems before export



This position requires genuine experience across the Edit, Fusion, Color and Fairlight pages—not simply basic cutting or the use of pre-made templates.



REQUIREMENTS



• Advanced knowledge of DaVinci Resolve Studio 21

• A legitimate DaVinci Resolve Studio licence

• Strong Fusion motion-graphics experience

• Confident colour-grading and Fairlight audio skills

• Proven experience editing long-form documentaries or cinematic historical content

• Excellent visual storytelling and artistic judgement

• Strong English comprehension

• Ability to take over and safely manage an existing Resolve project

• Reliable communication and careful version control

• Respect for deadlines and project confidentiality



All newly introduced footage, music, fonts, graphics and other assets must be properly licensed or confirmed as suitable for commercial YouTube use. Any third-party plugins, fonts or generated assets must be disclosed before they are added.



DELIVERABLES



• A clean and fully relinked DaVinci Resolve Studio 21 project

• Project archive or project file with all newly added media

• Final master export at the existing timeline resolution and frame rate

• YouTube-ready export

• List of any new assets, fonts or plugins introduced

• Brief summary of the principal changes made

• One reasonable revision following my review



PAID TEST



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a paid 60–90 second creative test using a selected section from the documentary. This will allow me to assess artistic judgement, technical ability and compatibility with the established style. No unpaid test work will be requested.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin the first line of your application with the words “GILDED 21” so I know you have read the complete description.



Please include:



1. Your exact DaVinci Resolve Studio version.

2. Direct links to two or three relevant long-form documentary projects.

3. A clear explanation of your personal contribution to each example.

4. Details of your Fusion, Color and Fairlight experience.

5. Your hourly or project rate.

6. Your availability and earliest possible starting date.

7. A short explanation of how you keep an archival documentary visually engaging without over-editing it.



A general showreel alone is not sufficient. I need to see complete documentary sequences demonstrating pacing, atmosphere, motion graphics and storytelling.



This is initially a single finishing project. However, strong work could lead to ongoing documentary editing opportunities for the right person.

title: Amazon Online Arbitrage Product Researcher — US Market
description:
Join an established, long-term Amazon business. We have been operating for over 4 years and are building a stable remote team, not hiring for a short-term, high-turnover role. One of our current team members will reach 3 years with us this October.



We offer structured onboarding, ongoing support, performance reviews and genuine opportunities to increase your earnings as you grow in the role.



Salary: ₱30,000 per month

Bonuses: Monthly performance-based bonus scheme available from day one. Bonuses are based on the value of approved leads we actually purchase, not simply the number of leads submitted.

Performance review: Salary increase review within the first 3 months, based on performance

Other benefits: 22 days paid leave, 13th-month pay and long-term progression opportunities

Hours: Full-time, 8 hours per day. You may choose your start time, provided your 8 hours are completed by 5:00 PM Philippine time each working day.

Location: Remote - Philippines-based applicants



We are an established US-focused Amazon online arbitrage business looking for an experienced, detail-oriented Amazon Product Researcher to join our remote team.



Your role will be to find profitable products from US online retailers and analyse them for resale on Amazon US.



This is not an entry-level role. We are looking for someone who already understands US online arbitrage and can confidently assess leads using the relevant software and Amazon data.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



• Research profitable online-arbitrage products from US retailers every day

• Analyse potential products using Keepa and SellerAmp SAS

• Check sales rank, price history, offer count, estimated sales, competition, fees, ROI and profit margins

• Create and maintain accurate product-lead spreadsheets, including source links, buy cost, selling price, ROI, profit, BSR, seller count and relevant notes

• Identify and avoid restricted brands, gated products, hazmat items, IP-risk products, bundles and other unsuitable leads

• Look for discounts, cashback opportunities, retailer promotions and valid discount codes where relevant

• Stay up to date with Amazon policies, OA sourcing practices and retailer changes

• Consistently identify high-quality, buyable leads. As a general guide, strong researchers often submit around 5–10 suitable leads per day, but quality and purchase value matter more than raw lead volume

• Communicate clearly with the team and respond positively to feedback



PRODUCTS WE PREFER



We source across a range of categories, but our strongest areas generally include:



• Tools and home improvement

• Coffee and kitchen-related products

• Clothing and footwear

• Electronics and accessories

• Household and practical consumer products



We are generally not focused on beauty, and we do not usually prioritise toys and games. Experience sourcing in our preferred categories is a strong advantage.



ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS



To be considered, you must have:



• At least 12 months of hands-on Amazon online-arbitrage product research experience for the US marketplace

• Fluent written and spoken English; this is essential for the role

• Strong working knowledge of Keepa and SellerAmp SAS

• Experience analysing genuine OA opportunities rather than simply using automated scans without verification

• Excellent attention to detail and the ability to work carefully and independently

• Confidence using Google Sheets or Excel

• A reliable computer, stable high-speed internet connection and professional work-from-home setup

• Willingness to use time-tracking software during working hours



Experience with cashback sites, retailer discount strategies and coupon finding is also highly valued.



PAY, BONUS AND GROWTH



Your starting base salary will be ₱30,000 per month.



We will carry out a performance and salary review within your first 3 months. Strong performance can lead to an increase in base salary.



In addition, we have a well-established monthly bonus scheme. It is already built, tested and available from your first day; it is not a promise for later.



The scheme rewards quality, not volume. Your bonus is based on what we actually spend buying the leads you find. When you find a genuinely strong deal, we can buy it in depth — and you share in that directly. One excellent lead that we can buy in quantity can be worth far more than twenty average ones.



We are not asking you to submit leads simply to hit a number. We are looking for deals that are genuinely safe, profitable and worth buying. Researchers who consistently find these opportunities can earn a substantial additional amount through the scheme.



We are looking for a dependable long-term team member. We provide clear feedback, fair performance expectations and opportunities to develop within the business.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send a tailored application and CV. We receive a very high volume of applications, so generic copy-and-paste responses will not be considered.



We want to understand why your experience is suitable for this role, the categories you have sourced in, and how you approach evaluating an OA lead.



SHOW US YOUR WORK



This is the part of the application we care about most. Please choose one option:



OPTION A: Attach or share several sample leads or a sample lead spreadsheet. Screenshots or a view-only Google Sheets link are welcome. Please remove or blur confidential information from previous employers.



OPTION B: If you cannot share previous work, find one current live lead and show your analysis: source link, buy cost, expected selling price, Amazon fees, ROI and a brief explanation of why you believe it is a worthwhile purchase.



Either option is acceptable. We would rather see one lead that you have genuinely analysed than a long generic description of your process. A submitted demonstration lead is for assessment purposes and does not guarantee that we will purchase it.



Please also answer the following in your application:



1. How many years of Amazon online-arbitrage product research experience do you have, specifically for Amazon US?

2. Which product categories and US retailers do you have the most experience sourcing from? Please mention whether you have sourced in areas such as tools, home improvement, clothing, electronics, coffee, kitchen or household goods.

3. Which tools do you use for OA research and analysis? Keepa and SellerAmp SAS experience is required.

4. What daily lead volume and approval rate have you achieved in previous OA roles? Please briefly outline the checks you normally make before submitting a lead.

5. Are you currently working for another Amazon OA seller or sourcing agency? If so, please briefly explain whether there would be any conflict of interest.

6. Are you comfortable using time-tracking software, and when would you be available to start?



Include the word "Copper" in your
 subject line. Applications without this word in the subject line will be ignored.



Please do not submit a bulk or generic template application. We can quickly identify applications that have not been written specifically for this vacancy, and they will not be considered.

title: Senior Funnel Builder
description:
Senior Funnel Builder

Remote | USD $5–$8/hour



We’re looking for a Senior Funnel Builder who thinks beyond the build.



Yes, you should know how to build and maintain high-performing funnels. But more importantly, you should understand why a funnel converts, what makes a product win, and how to turn those insights into new opportunities.



You’ll work closely with our Product Manager and Creative Lead to build, optimize, and continuously improve our funnel portfolio. If you enjoy looking at data, spotting opportunities, testing ideas, and turning one successful concept into several strong variations, we’d love to hear from you.



What You’ll Do



Build, maintain, and optimize funnels using Funnelish.

Conduct regular funnel and quality checks to make sure everything works smoothly.

Review funnels from both a technical and conversion-focused perspective.

Analyze winning products and funnels to understand what is driving their performance.

Create meaningful variations of winning funnels, products, and offers without losing what made the original successful.

Test new angles, offers, hooks, messaging, positioning, and funnel structures.

Write and refine conversion-focused copy, including headlines, hooks, CTAs, offers, upsells, and product messaging.

Use testing and performance insights to continuously improve conversion rates.

Help establish and maintain strong funnel-building and optimization practices across the team.



What We’re Looking For

- 2+ years of experience building and optimizing sales funnels.

- Strong hands-on experience with Funnelish, or the ability to become highly proficient with it quickly.

- Strong conversion-focused copywriting skills.

- A solid understanding of funnel structure, customer journeys, offers, and conversion principles.

- Experience with winner optimization, A/B testing, and developing variations from successful funnels or products.

- The ability to think beyond simply changing colors, layouts, or buttons—you should be able to develop new angles, offers, hooks, and messaging based on what the data is telling you.

- A strong eye for design, usability, and detail.

- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

- Someone who is proactive, reliable, curious, and comfortable working independently.

- CheckoutChamp experience is a plus, but not required.



What Makes You a Great Fit



You don’t just know how to build a funnel, you understand why it converts.

When you see a winning product, you naturally start asking:



Why is this working? What angle is resonating with customers? Which part of the offer is driving the conversion? What other hooks or messages could we test? How can we create new variations without losing what made the original winner successful?



You’re comfortable bringing together technical execution, copywriting, conversion strategy, analysis, and creative testing.



Most importantly, you know how to take one good winner and turn it into multiple opportunities.



How to Apply



When applying, please tell us about your experience with:



1. Funnelish

2. Winner optimization

3. Conversion-focused copywriting

4. Shopify automations

5. Creating variations from successful products or funnels

6. CheckoutChamp, if applicable



We’re particularly interested in hearing about specific examples of funnels or products you’ve worked on, what you changed, why you changed it, and what happened as a result.

title: Tender & Bid Coordinator | NZ Civil & Infrastructure | Remote Philippines
description:
Taylor Contractors is seeking an experienced Tender & Bid Coordinator to support the preparation and submission of tenders for New Zealand council, government, commercial and infrastructure contracts.

This is not a general VA or administration role.

We are specifically looking for someone with previous experience preparing New Zealand construction, civil, utilities or infrastructure tender submissions.

You will work closely with our Quantity Surveyor, Operations team and Directors to coordinate tender opportunities from initial identification through to final submission.

The Quantity Surveyor will primarily manage estimating, pricing and commercial components. Your responsibility will be to coordinate, prepare, build and quality-check the overall tender submission.

Key Responsibilities

Monitor NZ tender portals, council procurement channels and other relevant sources for suitable opportunities

Review ROI, EOI, RFP and RFT documentation

Download, organise and maintain complete tender documentation

Review tender requirements and prepare submission checklists

Identify mandatory requirements, deadlines, deliverables and evaluation criteria

Coordinate the tender programme from opportunity identification through submission

Prepare and format professional tender responses

Draft and coordinate non-price attributes

Assist with methodology and delivery-plan documentation using information supplied by Operations and technical staff

Prepare company capability and experience sections

Coordinate project case studies and track-record information

Prepare and maintain key-personnel CVs and supporting documentation

Coordinate Health & Safety, environmental, quality and compliance information

Manage tender forms, schedules, appendices and supporting documents

Work alongside the Quantity Surveyor on schedules of prices and commercial information

Liaise with Operations regarding methodology, resources, plant, personnel and programme

Track tender questions, clarifications and addenda

Ensure all tender requirements have been addressed before submission

Proofread and quality-check submissions for accuracy, consistency and professionalism

Package and submit completed tenders before deadlines

Maintain a central tender register showing opportunities, deadlines, status and outcomes

Maintain a structured tender content library for future submissions

Continuously improve Taylor Contractors' tender templates, capability statements and submission systems

Required Experience

Applicants should have:

Previous experience preparing New Zealand tender submissions

Experience within construction, civil infrastructure, utilities, plumbing, drainage, three waters or a related contracting environment

Understanding of NZ procurement and tender terminology

Experience working with ROI/EOI, RFP and RFT processes

Strong experience preparing non-price tender responses

Strong Microsoft Word, Excel and document-formatting skills

Excellent written English

Strong attention to detail

Ability to interpret large tender documents and identify mandatory requirements

Ability to manage multiple deadlines without constant supervision

Experience working remotely with New Zealand or Australian businesses

Experience with NZ councils, government procurement or GETS opportunities will be highly regarded.

Highly Desirable

Experience preparing submissions involving:

Civil construction

Three Waters infrastructure

Watermain renewals

Wastewater and stormwater

Drainage

Plumbing

Hydro excavation

Utilities

Roading and reinstatement

Maintenance contracts

Council panel contracts

Infrastructure maintenance and renewals

Experience with NZ contract environments such as NZS 3910 / NZS 3917 would also be valuable.

How the Role Works

The Tender & Bid Coordinator will not be expected to independently price major contracts.

Responsibilities will generally be divided as follows:

Tender & Bid Coordinator

Tender management → compliance → documentation → non-price attributes → formatting → coordination → submission

Quantity Surveyor

Take-offs → estimating → supplier/subcontractor pricing → schedules of prices → margins → commercial review

Operations / Technical Team

Methodology → programme → resources → plant → personnel → technical delivery information

Directors / Management

Tender strategy → major commercial decisions → final approval

The Tender & Bid Coordinator is responsible for bringing these components together into one complete, compliant and professional submission.

What Success Looks Like

You will be successful in this role when:

Suitable tender opportunities are consistently identified

Tender deadlines are never missed

Submission requirements are identified early

Mandatory documents are never a
 omitted

Tender documentation is organised and easy to review

Management and the QS know exactly what information they need to provide and by when

Submissions are professional, consistent and compliant

Reusable tender content is maintained and continually improved

Taylor Contractors can submit more high-quality tenders without creating additional workload for Directors

Tender outcomes and feedback are recorded and used to improve future submissions

Important

Previous New Zealand tender experience is essential.

This position is not suitable for someone looking to learn tendering from scratch.

We are looking for someone who understands how New Zealand contractors tender for work and can demonstrate previous involvement in preparing genuine NZ tender submissions.

Application Requirements

Please provide:

CV

Details of your previous New Zealand construction/infrastructure experience

Types of NZ tenders you have worked on

Industries/contracts you have tendered for

Your specific responsibilities within those submissions

Examples of tender documentation or redacted work samples where legally permitted

NZ companies or contractors you have previously supported

Software and procurement platforms you have used

Do not provide confidential material belonging to previous employers or clients.

title: Product Sourcing & Deal Research Specialist – USA to Philippines
description:
Hello!



USA Express (
) is looking for a sharp, curious, deal-hunting **Product Sourcing & Deal Research Specialist** who genuinely enjoys finding great products before everyone else does.



** This is not a traditional Amazon VA position. **



We are not buying products in the U.S. to resell on Amazon in the U.S.



We are looking for someone who can help us spot great American products, catch them when the price drops, and identify which ones have strong resale potential in the Philippines.



If you are the kind of person who sees a major Best Buy sale and immediately wonders, “What here is selling for way more in the Philippines?” — this may be a very good fit.



## What You’ll Be Doing



You’ll spend your working time actively searching for opportunities across U.S. retailers such as Amazon, Walmart, Best Buy, Target, Costco, major brand websites, department stores, outlets, and other reputable sellers. Previous experience in e-commerce, product research, online shopping, sourcing, or marketplace research is helpful, but not required. We care just as much about curiosity, communication, reliability, and your ability to learn quickly.



You’ll be watching for:



* Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals

* Christmas and holiday promotions

* New Year sales

* Flash sales

* Clearance events

* Temporary price drops

* Brand promotions

* Outlet deals

* Seasonal discounts

* Any unusually strong buying opportunity



When you find something interesting, you’ll research whether it has strong resale potential in the Philippines.



That means looking at things like:



* Philippine selling prices

* Local availability and scarcity

* Demand

* Brand desirability

* Trending or viral interest

* Availability of authentic products locally

* Potential profit after purchasing and shipping



The goal is simple:



Find products that are available at an unusually attractive price in the U.S. AND could sell strongly in the Philippines — then identify them quickly enough for us to act before the deal disappears.



## ChatGPT Will Be Part of Your Daily Work



You should be very comfortable using ChatGPT and other AI tools.



We expect you to use AI actively for:



* Product research

* Market comparisons

* Philippine pricing research

* Trend discovery

* Finding new sourcing ideas

* Evaluating potential opportunities

* Organizing your findings



AI should make you faster and smarter, but you will still be responsible for verifying important prices, product listings, availability, and market information.



## Who We’re Looking For



Relevant experience could include:



* Product research

* E-commerce sourcing

* Online or retail arbitrage

* Amazon FBA research

* Purchasing

* Shopify product research

* Marketplace research

* Competitor research

* Price comparison



Previous Amazon VA experience can definitely help, but you must understand that this job is different.



We are sourcing products in America specifically because we believe they can perform well in the Philippine market.



We want someone who is:



* Curious

* Resourceful

* Fast online

* Good at spotting unusual deals

* Comfortable comparing prices

* Familiar with Lazada, Shopee, TikTok Shop, and Philippine e-commerce

* Strong with ChatGPT and AI-assisted research

* Able to explain why a product is worth buying, not just send us a link



## Schedule & Pay



20 hours per week, ₱4,000 per week to start. Paid weekly



This is an active research role. We need someone consistently looking for opportunities throughout the week, especially during major U.S. promotional periods.



At first, you will research and recommend purchases.



As you demonstrate good judgment and consistently find strong opportunities, you may later be given a purchasing budget and authority to place approved orders directly.



There is plenty of room for this role to grow.



## How to Apply...Please send us:



1. A short introduction

2. Your relevant product research, sourcing, e-commerce, or arbitrage experience

3. How you currently use ChatGPT or AI in your work

4. In 2–3 sentences, explain how this role is different from traditional Amazon online arbitrage



Start your application with: **USA TO PHILIPPINES**



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a small product-sourcing exercise.



If you enjoy researching products, spotting deals, comparing markets, and finding opportunities other people miss, we’d love to hear from you!

Industry Experience: Proven background in structural steel, metalwork, or civil construction.

Amazon PPC Manager

About this role:

We're bringing on a PPC Manager to own paid acquisition end-to-end and not run ads on someone else's instructions, but set the strategy, defend the numbers, and answer for the outcome. This is a leadership seat inside performance marketing. You'll direct campaign architecture, mentor whoever sits under you, and report spend performance the way an owner would, not the way a contractor would. If you've only ever executed someone else's brief, this isn't the fit. We need someone who has held the P&L for a paid channel before — who has said "no" to a client's bad idea and been right about it.





What You'll Own:

•Account strategy — Build and defend the PPC roadmap: budget allocation, platform mix, testing cadence, and where the next dollar of spend should go

•Performance accountability — Report ROAS, CAC, and spend efficiency in terms leadership actually cares about — not vanity metrics, not dashboard theater

•Cross-functional coordination — Sit at the table with creative, ops, and leadership to keep paid acquisition aligned with the bigger commercial picture

•Escalation judgment — D
 what needs your attention immediately versus what can wait, and make that call correctly, consistently





What We Need From You:

•3+ years running paid campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, and at least one other platform (Amazon Ads, TikTok Ads, or similar)

•Direct experience managing people or vendors, not just managing budgets — this is a supervisory role, and we'll ask you to prove it

•A track record of catching underperformance before it becomes a crisis, not after

•Comfort presenting numbers to non-marketing stakeholders without dumbing it down or drowning it in jargon

•Fluency with attribution, incrementality, and the limits of last-click data — you should know where the numbers lie to you





Nice to Have

•Experience scaling an account from a modest budget to six figures in monthly spend

title: SEO Expert
description:
About RemovalistNow



RemovalistNow is an Australian removalist comparison platform that helps people planning local, interstate, home, apartment and office moves compare removalist options and make more informed decisions.



We are seeking a proactive SEO Outreach & Backlink Specialist to build relevant publisher relationships and strengthen our organic visibility. This is not a bulk
 or spam role. We want someone who can find high-quality opportunities, write personalised outreach, manage conversations and keep precise records.



The role covers both earned editorial backlinks and paid placement coordination. Quality, relevance and careful execution are more important than sending a high volume of
s.



Core Responsibilities



You will research relevant websites, publishers, journalists, bloggers and content creators for RemovalistNow. The best opportunities will be related to moving house, relocation, property, first-home buyers, home improvement, interiors, local services, real estate and Australian consumer advice.



You will pursue unpaid editorial opportunities through personalised outreach. This can include resource-page inclusions, expert quotes, useful moving guides, original guest articles, local-business features, relevant partnerships, broken-link opportunities and genuine editorial mentions. Your role is to create a compelling reason for the publisher to mention a useful RemovalistNow resource.



You will also coordinate paid link insertions and sponsored guest-post opportunities. For each offer, you will collect the exact article URL, placement location, price, target audience, link type, duration, renewal terms and proposed anchor text. You will prepare a clear opportunity summary for approval before any deal is accepted.



You will maintain a detailed Google Sheet that records every prospect, contact name,
, publisher website, article URL, website topic, country/audience if available, outreach date, follow-up date, reply status, price, proposed link target, anchor text, placement details and final live-link status.



You will send approved personalised outreach
s and professional follow-ups. You will also coordinate the submission of approved guest articles and confirm each placement after it is published by checking the live destination URL, anchor text, page context and link attribute.



Quality Standard



We only want links that are relevant, visible and useful to readers. A strong opportunity normally has an existing article about moving, home ownership, relocation, property or a related home-service topic. The preferred placement is a natural, in-body contextual link on a permanent page.



You must avoid generic directories, link farms, irrelevant lifestyle sites, casino/adult/CBD content, automated mass outreach and sites where the proposed placement cannot be verified. Do not recommend an opportunity only because it is cheap or claims to offer a do-follow link.



Approval Rules



You may research, draft
s, follow up and manage the outreach spreadsheet independently. However, you must receive written approval before you accept a paid offer, agree to a price, provide final link instructions, submit an article, promise a publication date, make a payment or share payment information.



You must never pay invoices, enter payment details, access financial accounts, create website logins, publish content on our website or change RemovalistNow pages. You must not promise search rankings or use misleading outreach claims.



Skills and Experience



You must write excellent English and be confident communicating with website owners and editors. You should have practical experience in manual SEO outreach, digital PR, guest-post outreach, editorial link building or publisher relationship management.



You should be comfortable researching websites with Google, Google Sheets, Gmail and SEO tools such as Semrush, Ahrefs or equivalent platforms. You need to understand the difference between a genuine editorial in-body link and a low-value directory or generic paid-post listing.



Experience working with Australian websites, home services, property, real estate, local services, moving or relocation content is an advantage. Strong attention to detail, reliable follow-up and good judgement are essential.



Initial Paid Trial



The successful applicant will begin with a two-week paid trial. During the trial, you will research high-quality prospects, build a clean outreach sheet, draft personalised outreach
s and follow up only on approved conversations.



A successful trial will demonstrate that you can identify relevant articles, explain why a placement is valuable, write professional outreach and follow processes carefully. Quality and accuracy matter more than the number of
s sent.

- Plan ad batches across TOF (attention), MOF (trust/mechanism), and BOF (offer/conversion) for multiple brands simultaneously

- Assign every ad concept to the correct awareness stage — Unaware, Problem Aware, Solution Aware, Product Aware, Most Aware — and defend that choice

- Research competitors and winning ads through Ad Library, spy tools, and swipe files — then translate what you find into original concepts for our brands

- Write full creative briefs for editors: hook, copy, visual layout, CTA, reference images, and funnel-stage context

- Review finished creatives before launch — checking copy accuracy, offer consistency, visual quality, and funnel-stage fit

- Read performance data (hook rate, CTR, ATC, CPA, ROAS) and use it to iterate: kill what doesn't work, scale what does, and explain why



You are not designing ads. You are not editing video. You are the person who makes the decisions that determine whether our ads convert.



Who This Is For



This role is for someone who has done this work before — not someone who wants to learn it.



You should have:



- 2+ years working as a Creative Strategist, Performance Creative Lead, or Media Buyer who also handled creative direction — in ecommerce, DTC, dropshipping, or direct response

- A real understanding of TOF / MOF / BOF and the 5 awareness stages that goes beyond definitions — you should be able to look at any ad and immediately identify where it belongs and what's wrong with it

- Experience strategizing static image ads (our primary format)

- Experience with native ad formats (creator-style, editorial, story-based) is a strong advantage

- The ability to look at a landing page and reverse-engineer what ad angles, hooks, and awareness stages will work for it

- Excellent written English — your briefs need to be clear enough that editors produce what you intended on the first pass

- Own computer, reliable internet, and genuinely available full-time (this cannot be combined with another full-time job)

What You Get

$2,500 USD/month — paid on time, every month, no exceptions

Paid leave — real paid days off

Long-term stability — team members have been with us for years; we promote from within and invest in people who deliver

No project-based uncertainty — consistent full-time workload across multiple brands

An experienced international team — you are joining people who know what they are doing, not managing chaos

How to Apply



We do not want a generic CV or a list of companies you worked at. We want to see how you think.



Step 1 — Show us your work Send at least 5 static ads where YOU were the strategist (not the designer). Include performance numbers if you have them.



Step 2 — Quick exercise (15 minutes) Go to this landing page: [INSERT LANDER URL]



Give us 3 ad concepts — one TOF, one MOF, one BOF. For each, just the hook and awareness stage. That's it. Bullet points, no explanation needed — we can see from your choices whether you get it.



Step 3 — Start date Tell us your earliest available start date.



Applications without the exercise will not be reviewed. We personally read every qualified application and reply within 5 business days.

 marketing issue.



We recently changed our store domain and brand name, but we are still using the same Klaviyo account and the same
 flows. Before the domain change, our Klaviyo flows were performing well and generating consistent revenue.
