Klaviyo sending domain setup

Branded sending domain

SPF, DKIM and DMARC records

Sender
 settings

Domain reputation after the domain change

 deliverability and inbox placement

Branded click tracking

Shopify/Klaviyo integration

Checkout Started / Started Checkout events

Flow triggers

Flow filters and skipped recipients

Suppressed/unsubscribed profiles

 attribution and revenue tracking

Whether the flows are sending correctly

Whether
s are landing in spam, promotions, or not being delivered properly

We are not looking for someone who only designs
s or writes better copy. We need someone who understands Klaviyo deliverability, domain setup, flow tracking, Shopify integration, and technical
 performance.

title: Senior Copywriter For Email Marketing Agency
description:
We're a boutique
 marketing agency building world-class Klaviyo programs for Shopify brands in fashion, spirits, jewelry, and beyond. We're small, fast, and obsessive about craft.



We're looking for a senior
 copywriter who'll rewrite a subject line twenty times, then cut a line they love because it doesn't sound like the brand.



What you'll do:



Own the words for multiple brands: concepting, writing, and shipping
 and SMS copy that gets designed, built in Klaviyo, and sent to hundreds of thousands of subscribers. Subject lines, preview text, body copy, CTAs, all of it.



Every week you move between brand worlds. High-end modest fashion one hour, premium whisky the next, streetwear after lunch. Each one has its own voice, and you switch between them without missing a beat. You'll work with our designers and strategists to turn briefs into
s that stop the scroll and move revenue.



And the more you show us, the more you shape. The best writers here don't just write to the brief, they help d
 what the brief should be: the angle, the offer, the calendar, the strategy behind the send.



How it works:



This is a per-account role. You're paid per account you own, and the better you do, the more accounts you get. There's no ceiling. Deliver, and you keep earning more. How far this goes is up to you.



Who we're looking for:



• 3+ years writing
 copy, specifically. Not "I write, and some of it was
." Real campaigns, real results, real revenue. You know the medium cold: the subject line, the preview text, the first line, scannability, the CTA, and how copy maps to a Klaviyo block structure.

• Native-level English on the page. Not just correct, but idiom, rhythm, and the instinct for when to break a rule. You write English that sounds like a person, not a translation and not a textbook.

• A body of work that makes us jealous. Voice, rhythm, restraint, taste. Your
s read like someone wrote them for a brand they love, not like a template and not like a prompt.

• You're a voice chameleon. You can sound like premium whisky in the morning and streetwear by lunch, and neither one sounds like you. Brand voice isn't a vibe you approximate. It's something you nail, every time.

• AI is already in your toolkit, and you've figured out how to use it without sounding like it. Claude, ChatGPT, whatever sharpens your thinking and speeds up your drafts. But you'd never let an "elevate," an "unleash," or an "in a world where" slip into a send. You know the difference between AI that makes you faster and AI that makes you generic, and you only ship the first kind. If you're scared of AI, or addicted to its first draft, this isn't the role.

• You understand
 as a discipline, not just a writing assignment. You know what a flow is, why segmentation changes what you write, and how the offer and the angle move revenue. Bonus points if you can build the strategy, not just write to it.

• You get design. You write with the layout in mind: how copy breaks across blocks, where the eye lands, what the headline does next to the hero. You'll push back on a layout that fights the words instead of just filling it in.

• You overlap with Israel hours. Wherever you're based, your workday meets ours. This one is non-negotiable. We move fast and need you in the room, even when the room is Slack.





Why it's worth it: 



• Your words ship, unwatered. We're small enough that nothing dies in committee. What you write Monday is in inboxes by Friday.

• Brands worth writing for. Our clients care how they sound. No "just make it pop" briefs, no "add three more exclamation points," and a body of work you'll be proud of.

• Direct feedback, fast growth. We tell you what's working and what isn't. No politics, no guessing where you stand.





We live by five values: Unreasonable Hospitality, Design + Details, Extreme Ownership, Relentlessly Resourceful, and Clarity is King. If reading those made you nod, we should talk. If they made you roll your eyes, we won't.



How to apply

PAIN SCRIBE - ECW WORKFLOW

title: Brand Manager - Amazon Private Label | 3+ Years Experience
description:
Who We Are

BTS Brands is an 8-year-old private label company selling across the US, CA, UK, EU, AU and JP, and expanding into Saudi Arabia — two brands (travel accessories and beauty devices), 52+ active SKUs. We're moving from a founder-run business to a systems-run one, and this role owns the commercial result.



The Role

This is commercial ownership, not task execution. You own the P&L, the launches and the positioning for both brands, and you make the day-to-day commercial calls that today land on the founders' desk. You report to the two Founders.

If you need to be told what to do each day, this isn't for you. If you read a portfolio yourself, commit to a decision and defend it with numbers rather than hand it back - read on.



What You'll Own



- The P&L at ASIN level across both brands and every marketplace — built by you, after fees, ads, returns and storage.

- A quarterly kill / hold / invest call on every product, and a weekly report to the founders.

- Every launch end to end, from the pre-launch gate to the scale-or-stop decision.

- Positioning, SEO / keywords, and the commercial PPC targets (TACOS / ROAS) — PPC is run day-to-day by an in-house specialist, so you own the targets and steer performance, not the campaign build.

- Diagnosing underperformance — traffic, conversion, price, reviews and product each need a different fix.

- Final approval on creative, copy and packaging before it publishes or prints — produced by two in-house designers who also edit video — judged on conversion, not taste.

- What we build next, together with R&D.



Tools You Should Know

- Amazon Seller Central (Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance, business reports) ·

- Amazon Ads · Helium 10 / Keepa ·

- Google Sheets (P&L models you build yourself) ·

- ClickUp,

- Slack,

- Drive.



Who We're Looking For

- 3+ years managing Amazon FBA brands accountable for the commercial result, not just execution.

- Strong, hands-on Amazon: you read Brand Analytics, SQP and business reports, and build your own P&L models in a spreadsheet.

- At least one full launch you can talk through end to end — including what went wrong.

- You've directed PPC against a target you owned.

- You bring a recommendation with the numbers attached, and you'll tell us an uncomfortable truth rather than sit on it.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

DTC / website experience alongside the marketplace is a plus.

- Commercial ownership starts on day one, and the role is built to grow toward leadership.



Compensation & Setup

- $1,600–$2,000/month based on experience

- Full-time, 40h/week, remote

- 14 days paid leave per year

- Long-term position — we invest in people who invest in us



To Apply - Required

Answer only from your own experience. Every answer must name a real company from your CV and use real numbers from that business. We're not asking what you would do - we're asking what you actually did. Hypothetical or generic answers (including AI-written ones) will not move forward:



1. Take one product you owned at a company on your CV. Walk us through its real unit economics - price, landed cost, Amazon fees, ad spend, return rate - and one decision you made because of those numbers.

2. Walk us through one launch you ran, at a named company - from PO to the scale-or-stop call. What was the plan, and what went wrong?

3. A product's sales fell at a company on your CV. What did you check, in what order - and what did you find and d
?

4. A listing, image or piece of copy you changed or refused to publish - what was wrong, what did you change, and what happened to sales after?



Please include your salary expectation and availability.

title: Education Consultant with Immigration Assistance Experience
description:
Imagine Global Edu & Migration (iGEM) is an international education and migration consultancy dedicated to helping students achieve their global education and career aspirations. With a strong presence across Australia, New Zealand and international markets including Thailand, Laos, the Philippines, and Latin America, iGEM provides comprehensive education and migration solutions, from student recruitment and visa support to pathway planning and settlement services. As a rapidly growing organisation, we pride ourselves on our supportive team culture, commitment to excellence, and passion for making a positive impact on students' lives worldwide.



We're Hiring! Education Consultant withe Immigration Assistance Experience (Philippines Market)

Location: Remote

Experience Level: Minimum 1 year experience in New Zealand education & migration industry



Role Overview

We are seeking an all-round, highly skilled Education & Migration Assistant with a broad and versatile understanding of the New Zealand immigration system. In this role, you will work directly alongside our Licensed Immigration Adviser (LIA) to manage a diverse case portfolio. The ideal candidate must be equally proficient in mapping out Student Pathways (from enrollment to visa), assessing eligibility for Skilled Migration and Residency, and accurately processing other temporary, work, and family visa types under Immigration New Zealand (INZ) policies.



Key Requirements & Qualifications

• Experience: Minimum 2 year of direct experience as a Migration Admin or Assistant, with a proven track record handling New Zealand visas.

• LIA Support: Proven experience assisting a Licensed Immigration Adviser (LIA) or Registered Migration Agent, with excellent case management preparation skills.

• Full-Spectrum Visa Knowledge: Strong, up-to-date understanding of the INZ Operational Manual across multiple streams

• Profile Assessment: Ability to accurately analyze client CVs, qualification credentials against the ANZSCO framework, and evaluate Genuine Student Intentions (GSI).

• Tools: Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Microsoft Teams, Canva, and CRM/case management software.



Key Responsibilities

1. Student Pathway & Enrollment Management

• Map out strategic education-to-migration roadmaps for international students, ensuring chosen programs align with long-term skilled career pathways or Green List profiles.

• Review and help clients refine their Statements of Purpose (SOP) to ensure they strongly reflect credible Genuine Student Intent criteria.

• Coordinate directly with New Zealand education institutions to secure Offers of Place and manage student enrollment deadlines.

• Check critical financial evidence markers, such as tracing genuine fund sources for student visa applicants.



2. Skilled Migration & Residency Pathway Assistance

• Support the LIA in evaluating client employment offers, ensuring duties match ANZSCO definitions and remuneration meets mandated Median Wage thresholds.

• Assist the LIA with checking and preparing Expressions of Interest (EOI) for the Skilled Migrant Category.

• Assemble evidence logs, tax summaries (IRD records), and employment references to prepare robust Residency and Permanent Residency packages.



3. Diverse Visa Processing & Administrative Support

• Populate and manage visa application forms accurately via the INZ online platform or paper channels across a wide array of categories (e.g., Student, Partner, Visitor, AEWV).

• Coordinate and track critical application steps, including NZQA International Qualifications Assessments (IQA), professional body registrations, and medical panel bookings.

• Conduct rigid internal audits to verify data consistency, completeness, and compliance across all documentation files before handing them to the LIA.

• Assist the LIA in drafting technical responses to INZ Requests for Further Information or Potentially Prejudicial Information (PPI) letters.



4. Records, Research & Client Communication

• Maintain regular, clear, and proactive communication with individual clients and corporate employers regarding application milestones and INZ processing statuses.

• Securely manage highly sensitive personal and financial client data under strict confidentiality protocols.

• Stay continuously updated on shifting immigration policies, sector agreements, and NZQA updates to ensure case accuracy.

title: Project Manager | Ecommerce Agency Full-Time | Remote
description:
About the Role



We’re looking for a highly organized, proactive Ecommerce Project Manager to keep multiple client projects moving from 0 to 100.



We are a well-staffed agency with dedicated teams across sourcing, branding, Shopify development, marketing, and account management. This role is not about doing everyone’s job, it’s about making sure everyone is doing their job, projects stay on track, communication is clear, and nothing falls through the cracks.



You’ll be the connective tissue between different teams and stakeholders. You’ll coordinate timelines, follow up on deliverables, identify bottlenecks, communicate clearly with clients and internal teams, and make sure projects continue progressing without unnecessary delays.



We work with a steady flow of ecommerce clients, with approximately 9 clients currently in various stages of offboarding and new clients coming in every month. This is a fast-moving environment where priorities can change quickly, so we need someone who can bring structure without becoming rigid.



What You’ll Be Doing



Own project coordination from kickoff through completion

Keep multiple ecommerce projects moving simultaneously

Coordinate across sourcing, branding, Shopify development, marketing, and account management

Make sure every stakeholder knows what needs to happen, who owns it, and when it is due

Track project timelines, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables

Follow up proactively when something is late, unclear, or at risk

Identify potential bottlenecks before they become major problems

Communicate updates clearly between internal teams, clients, and account managers

Hand projects and key information off smoothly to the appropriate Account Manager

Work closely with Account Managers so they can focus on higher-level client relationships and strategy

Keep ClickUp and project documentation organized and up to date

Help onboard new clients and coordinate the moving pieces during offboarding

Manage multiple projects without losing track of details

Jump into the weeds when necessary to solve problems and keep things moving

Use AI tools to improve project management, communication, documentation, research, and workflows

Continuously look for ways to make the agency more efficient and scalable



You’ll Work Across Teams Including:



Sourcing Team

Product sourcing, supplier communication, product information, timelines, and deliverables.

Branding Team

Brand strategy, creative direction, assets, revisions, and approvals.

Shopify Development Team

Website builds, development tasks, integrations, revisions, QA, and launch timelines.

Marketing Team

Marketing assets, campaigns, content, launch requirements, and ongoing deliverables.

Account Management

Ensuring projects are properly coordinated and handed off so the Account Manager has everything they need to manage the client relationship effectively

.

What We’re Looking For



You’re a strong communicator.

You can communicate clearly and professionally with different personalities, teams, and stakeholders. You know how to ask the right questions, clarify ambiguity, and make sure everyone understands the next step.

You’re highly proactive.



You don't wait for someone to tell you that a deadline is approaching. You see it coming, follow up, and make sure the work gets done.

You understand ecommerce.

You don't need to be an ecommerce expert or Shopify developer, but you should understand the basic ecosystem of an ecommerce business — products, sourcing, branding, websites, Shopify, marketing, launches, and the general flow of getting an ecommerce project from idea to execution.



You’re comfortable managing complexity.

You may have multiple clients, teams, deadlines, revisions, and moving parts happening at the same time. You can prioritize without becoming overwhelmed.



You’re willing to roll up your sleeves.



This is not a "send a few Slack messages and update a spreadsheet" PM role.

When something gets stuck, you investigate. When information is missing, you find it. When a process breaks, you help fix it.

You’re comfortable getting into the details when necessary to keep the larger project moving.

You have strong ownership.

You take responsibility for the outcome of the project, not just your individual task list.



You naturally think:

"What needs to happen next, and how do I make sure it happens?"



Required Qualifications



3+ years of experience in project management, operations, account coordination, or a similar role

Experience working with ecommerce, digital agencies, Shopify, or online businesses

Excellent written and verbal English

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

Excellent organization and attention to detail

Comfortable managing multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously

Experience coordinating across multiple departments or teams

Strong follow-up and accountability skills

Comfortable working in a remote, asynchronous environment

Comfortable learning new software and AI tools quickly

Experience with project management platforms such as ClickUp, Asana, 
, or similar



Our Tech Stack

You’ll work primarily with:

ClickUp — project management

Slack — team communication

Google Sheets / Google Workspace — tracking and documentation

Claude — AI-assisted research, documentation, communication, and workflows

Various AI and automation tools

You don't need to know every tool on day one. What matters is that you're tech-savvy, curious, and comfortable using AI to work faster and smarter.



What Success Looks Like

After you’re fully ramped up, projects should feel like they are constantly moving forward.

Deadlines don't sneak up on the team

Stakeholders know what they need to do

Bottlenecks are identified early

Clients aren't left wondering what is happening

Account Managers receive clean, organized handoffs

Teams have the information they need to execute

Projects move from 0 → 100 without unnecessary delays

Nothing falls through the cracks

You will become the person the team can rely on to make sure things keep ticking along.



Schedule & Availability

This is a full-time remote position.

You must be available for sufficient overlap with the team. The preferred schedule includes availability of at least 4 hours in the US (EST/ CST) for crossover, and the rest can be on any relevant time during the Philippine timezone. After the 60 day onboarding, an early-morning or split-shift schedule may be considered depending on the candidate and team requirements.



Because we work across multiple teams and client accounts, flexibility and responsiveness during agreed working hours are important.



Time Tracking

This position requires diligent and accurate time tracking through Time Doctor.



We value productivity, accountability, and transparency, and time tracking is an important part of how we manage remote team performance.



Who Will Thrive in This Role



This role is a great fit for someone who:

Loves turning chaos into organized action

Naturally follows up with people

Doesn't need to be micromanaged

Can communicate with both strategic and execution-focused people

Enjoys working across multiple departments

Is comfortable with fast-moving ecommerce businesses

Uses AI as a productivity multiplier

Notices problems before others do

Is comfortable saying, "This is stuck — here's what I'm doing about it."

Takes ownership instead of making excuses

Is willing to get into the details when needed

Who This Role Is NOT For

This probably isn't the right role if you:

Need someone to give you a checklist every morning

Prefer working on one task at a time with minimal interruptions

Don't enjoy following up with people

Avoid difficult conversations or accountability

Are uncomfortable working across multiple teams

Consider project management purely administrative

Wait for problems to become urgent before addressing them

We already have strong people on our teams. We need someone who can bring those people together and make the entire machine run better.



Why This Role Matters



We are growing, onboarding new clients every month, and managing increasingly complex ecommerce projects.

The right Project Manager will have a meaningful impact on how efficiently we operate.

You won't be hired simply to "manage tasks."

You'll be responsible for keeping projects moving, connecting teams, removing bottlenecks, and helping turn client projects into finished results.



Reply with a cover letter, why you're a fit for this role, and the name of your favourite country in the subject line.

What You’ll Do

- A pre-built prospect list and cold-calling script

- UK calling software and business number

- Objection-handling guide

- Regular feedback and support



You will not be expected to source your own leads or use your personal telephone number.



Two-Week Trial Expectations

During the paid trial, we expect approximately:

- 50–55 call attempts daily

- 500–550 call attempts across two weeks

- Accurate logging of every outcome

- Consistent follow-up on callbacks

- Genuine qualified appointments, not unconfirmed or unsuitable bookings



Performance will be assessed based on reliability, call quality, decision-maker conversations, accurate reporting and qualified appointments, not call volume alone.



What We’re Looking For

- Excellent spoken English that is clear and easy for UK business owners to understand

- Previous cold-calling, telemarketing, appointment-setting or BPO experience

- B2B calling experience is strongly preferred

- Confident and conversational telephone manner

- Reliable internet connection, good-quality headset and quiet working environment

- Comfortable using computer-based calling software, spreadsheets and simple CRM tools

- Able to work consistently during the agreed UK-hours shift



Compensation and Progression

- Starting rate: $6 USD per hour

- 20 hours per week during the initial paid trial

- BiWeekly payment

- $40 USD commission for every closed client generated from an appointment you book

- Long-term work available for consistent performers

- Opportunity for increased hours and a higher hourly rate based on performance



How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:

- Attach a 60 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you are suitable for the role.

- State your availability in UK time.

- Briefly describe your cold-calling or appointment-setting experience.

Applications without a voice recording or UK-time availability will not be considered.

description:
Role Overview



An electrical trade services business needs a highly organised, process-driven Administration Coordinator to own enquiries, invoicing, payroll inputs, records, and SOP documentation. This is not a receptionist role — the phone is already handled by an automated phone assistant — and it is not a bookkeeping role either; bookkeeping sits permanently with an external bookkeeper. The role is best understood as the connective tissue that turns a business currently run out of a couple of people's heads into one with proper systems behind it.



Every technical, on-the-tools decision is deliberately kept out of this role — it runs on lookup tables, written procedures, and a "draft, show, send" review rule — so success depends on accuracy, follow-through on chasing (invoices, quotes, records), and genuine comfort with writing documentation. A standout candidate will have real hands-on experience using Claude for actual work, not just chat — a meaningful part of the role is ongoing improvement projects done with Claude.



The role is deliberately split into two phases: phase one (below) is the job from day one, with phase two — quoting, scheduling, purchasing, vehicle/asset admin, and marketing admin — held back until phase one is running smoothly, expected around November 2026.



Working Hours: [TBC] Position Type: Administration Coordinator (Virtual Assistant)



What You'll Own



Enquiries & Job Creation



Triage incoming enquiries from shared inboxes

Forward enquiries into the job management system so the job gets created

Check the customer against existing records before creating a job, to avoid duplicate customer records

Use the correct job template so the job category is set from the start

Chase the photos and information a job needs before it can be quoted

Record how the customer heard about the business



Invoicing (worked twice weekly, oldest first)



Confirm the job is finished and has a work-done description

Capture who attended and the hours on site

Identify the correct payer behind the site record (often not the site itself)

Apply standing service call-out charges where relevant

Apply after-hours, weekend and public holiday loadings

Confirm the job category is set, then send the invoice

Chase overdue invoices

Reconcile job-management invoices against the accounting system (visibility only, not bookkeeping ownership)

Collect and bank cash and cheques



Payroll Inputs (inputs only — not bookkeeping)



Prepare labour hire timesheets for management approval

Track time-off-in-lieu and rostered-day-off balances

Track apprentice study/holiday days

Supply the bookkeeper with hours, leave, and other relevant data ahead of each pay run



Supplier Bills (limited, escalation-only scope)



Answer the bookkeeper's weekly list of supplier bills that could not be matched to a job

Escalate any bill still unmatched after a fortnight to management



Records & Systems



Maintain job management system forms and templates

Maintain client and site records

Keep the administration task board tidy (a separate board from the crew operations board)



Documentation & SOPs



Draft SOPs for review and correction

Record walkthrough videos

Sit in a weekly short check-in with the operations lead



Compliance & Registers



Maintain a register of who holds which licence, ticket, and clearance, with expiry dates

Renew workers compensation and obtain the certificate of currency

Maintain client compliance portals

Coordinate background/police checks for care and school sites



Projects & Continuous Improvement (using Claude)



Evaluate whether system add-ons are worth adopting, then set them up and train the team

Identify what in existing systems is slow, wrong, or duplicated, and fix it

Take on management-directed improvement projects — largely done with Claude, drafting procedures, reading job data, and building reporting

Keep a shared Claude context/reference set current (roughly an hour a week)



Explicitly not part of this role: bookkeeping (bank reconciliation, bill coding, pay runs, BAS), and answering the phone. Not part of phase one: quoting, scheduling, purchasing, vehicle/asset admin, and marketing admin.



What We're Looking For



Experience



3+ years' experience as a VA, Executive Assistant, or in operations/administration

Experience in a fast-growing or actively systemising small business is a plus

Trade, construction, or field-services background preferred, not required



Communication Skills



Strong written English suitable for customer-facing
s sent in the business's own name

Comfortable working within a "draft, show, send" review process rather than sending unsupervised

Plain, direct communication style — short, clear, no jargon



Technical Proficiency



Job management platform experience is an advantage, not a requirement — full training provided

Genuine, hands-on experience with Claude beyond a basic chat window — Claude Code, working with files and projects, connecting it to other systems. This is flagged as the single thing most likely to make an application stand out

Organisational Skills

title: Content Operations Manager / Content Coordinator
description:
We’re looking for a highly organized, resourceful Content Operations Manager to own the day-to-day content pipeline for a fast-growing personal brand and online education company.



This is less of a traditional “social media strategist” role and more of a **content project manager + implementer**.



We already have editors, existing content, established brand messaging, sales initiatives, AI tools, and systems for generating ideas and copy.



What we need is someone who can take all of those moving pieces and make sure content actually gets created, approved, published, and used to grow the audience and support the business — every single day.



The primary goal of this role is simple:



**Make sure the content machine runs even when the founder isn't personally running it.**



## What You'll Own



### Content Pipeline Management



You will own the content calendar and production pipeline across multiple social media accounts.



You'll make sure we're consistently publishing approximately **3–5 pieces of content per day**, which may include:



* Clips from podcasts, interviews, trainings, Lives, and long-form content

* Re-edited or repurposed existing content

* “Fan edit” / personality-driven edits

* Educational posts and carousels

* Promotional and direct-response content

* Trend-based or timely content

* Occasional newly created content

* Content for secondary brand accounts



You are not expected to personally edit every piece.



Instead, you'll identify what needs to be created, assign work to editors, track it through completion, gather assets and feedback, and make sure everything gets posted.



### Daily Instagram Stories



A major responsibility of this role is making sure **sales-focused Instagram Stories go live every day.**



Stories should consistently move followers toward actions such as:



* Applying to work with the company

* Joining a program

* Watching a training

* Registering for an event

* Responding to a CTA

* Engaging with a current campaign



We have custom AI tools, existing messaging, testimonials, offers, and campaign materials that can help generate the copy.



You'll be responsible for using those resources to turn the strategy into polished, on-brand Stories in Canva and getting them published.



You do not need to be an elite copywriter, but you should understand basic direct-response marketing and be comfortable using AI thoughtfully rather than simply copying and pasting whatever it produces.



### Editor & Team Coordination



You'll act as the central point of contact between the founder, editors, and the sales/marketing team.



This includes:



* Assigning content to editors

* Providing clear briefs, references, hooks, and source footage

* Tracking deadlines

* Following up when projects are stalled

* Organizing revisions

* Making sure completed edits don't disappear into Slack or a Drive folder

* Knowing what sales initiative we're currently prioritizing

* Translating promotions and launches into content needs

* Maintaining a backlog of content so we're not creating from zero every morning



If the sales team says, “We need more applications this week,” your job is to help turn that into an actionable content plan.



### Lightweight Content Creation



You should be comfortable creating simple content yourself when necessary.



Examples include:



* Canva carousels

* Quote graphics

* Instagram Stories

* Simple Reel edits

* Text overlays

* Basic montage or fan-style edits

* Resizing existing assets

* Repurposing existing posts

* Pulling clips or assets from existing content



You do **not** need to be an advanced video editor or motion graphics designer.



We care much more about speed, taste, resourcefulness, and consistency.



### Publishing & Quality Control



You will help ensure content is:



* Posted on schedule

* Correctly formatted for each platform

* Captioned appropriately

* Using the correct CTA

* Tagged and linked correctly

* Visually consistent with the brand

* Free of obvious errors

* Supporting current business priorities



The standard is not perfection.



The standard is **high-quality content consistently going live.**



### Content Performance



You'll monitor basic performance and help us learn from what's working.



You should be able to identify things like:



* Which hooks are outperforming

* Which topics drive applications or leads

* Which formats get shared

* Which posts generate follower growth

* Which Stories generate clicks, replies, or conversions



From there, you'll help us create more iterations of what is already working.



## What Success Looks Like



You're succeeding in this role when:



* 3–5 pieces of content are consistently publishing every day

* Sales-focused Instagram Stories are publishing every day

* The founder does not have to personally project-manage the content pipeline

* Editors always know what they're working on next

* There is a healthy backlog of upcoming content

* Promotions and sales initiatives are consistently supported by organic content

* Great footage and ideas aren't getting lost because nobody followed up on them

* The best-performing content gets identified and replicated

* The founder's involvement is increasingly concentrated on creating, performing, and making high-level creative decisions rather than chasing deliverables



## You Might Be Great for This Role If...



You're:



* Extremely organized

* Fast-moving and proactive

* Comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously

* Good at following up with people

* Comfortable holding editors accountable to deadlines

* Strong in Canva

* Capable of making simple video edits

* Familiar with Instagram, TikTok, and short-form content

* Familiar with ChatGPT and/or Claude

* Able to learn and use established AI prompts, agents, and workflows

* Comfortable working inside project-management systems

* Familiar with Google Drive and Slack

* Detail-oriented without becoming paralyzed by perfectionism

* Able to recognize what looks polished, modern, and native to social media

* Comfortable working in a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment



Bonus points if you understand:



* Direct-response marketing

* Personal brands

* Online education businesses

* Creator businesses

* Instagram Story selling

* Content repurposing

* Short-form video analytics



## This Role Is NOT



This is not primarily a:



* High-level video editor position

* Graphic designer position

* Copywriter position

* Sales setter position

* Community manager position



Those skills are helpful, but your superpower should be **making sure things get done and go live.**



We're looking for the person who sees 15 pieces of unfinished content spread across Slack, Google Drive, Canva, and multiple editors and thinks:



**“Perfect. I'll organize this.”**

title: Outbound Sales Representative — Australian Warehouse & Logistics Market
description:
Wise Solutions Group is an Australian labour hire and recruitment business based in South East Queensland, covering Brisbane, the Gold Coast and the Sunshine Coast.

We supply warehouse and production staff — pick packers, forklift operators, machine operators and general labour — to warehousing and distribution centres, 3PL and logistics operators, food processing plants, manufacturers, e-commerce fulfilment sites and cold storage facilities. We also place permanent management roles: warehouse managers, operations managers, supervisors and team leaders.

We are a small, direct team. There are no layers of management here. You will work directly with the business owner, and the work you do will visibly change the size of the company.

Website: 

The role in one line:

You find Australian warehouses that are short-staffed right now, you call them, and you turn that call into a client.

What you'll actually do:

Research. Our best prospects are businesses currently advertising for warehouse staff. An open job ad means they are short on the floor today, they have budget approved, and they are in pain. You will work job boards (Seek, Indeed), company career pages and LinkedIn to build a list of real employers — not recruitment agencies — across our target suburbs and industries.

Call. You will phone those businesses on an Australian number and get through to the person who feels the pain: usually the Operations Manager, Warehouse Manager or Production Manager. You will find out what roles they are short of, what volumes they run, whether they already use labour hire, and who makes the decision.

Qualify and log. Every conversation goes into HubSpot with proper notes. Our whole process runs on that data being accurate.

Follow up. Most of these will not close on the first call. You will send the rates
, call back, keep the prospect warm and keep the deal moving. This is where most salespeople give up and where you will make your money.

Hand over and grow into closing. For your first three months, once a lead is genuinely interested you hand it to the business owner to close, and you stay involved through the follow-up. After a successful three-month review, you take the process end to end yourself, right through to the first job order — at which point our account management team takes over the client relationship.

You are not responsible for managing clients after they sign. You open doors, you convert them, and you move to the next one.

Pay

All figures in Australian dollars. The peso equivalent will be agreed at signing and reviewed quarterly so exchange rate movement isn't your problem.

Months 1–3 Month 4 onwards

Hours 30 per week 40 per week

Base rate $9–10 AUD per hour $10–12 AUD per hour

Per qualified lead $10 $10

Per new client won $100 flat $100 / $200 / $350 — see below

Qualified lead — $10 each

A lead counts as qualified when you have:

spoken with the Operations, Warehouse or Production Manager, or someone more senior

confirmed they use labour hire, or would consider it

captured which roles they need and roughly what volumes

got their agreement to receive our rates

logged the contact and your notes in HubSpot

New client bonus

Paid once the client's first invoice has been settled, based on the total hours our workers place with that client in their first four weeks:

Hours placed in first 4 weeks Bonus

Under 75 hours $100

75–250 hours $200

Over 250 hours $350

Bigger accounts pay you more, because they're worth more to us. There is no cap on how many clients you can bring in.

What you could realistically earn

Once you're up to speed at 40 hours a week: base of around $1,730 per month, plus roughly $650 from a typical month of 25 qualified leads and two new clients — around $2,380 AUD per month, or approximately ₱90,000.

A strong month pays more. There is no ceiling on the bonuses.

title: Fractional Brand & Creative Designer
description:
About the Role



FounderSquare and Global Founder Index are looking for a part-time creative partner to elevate our marketing and sales materials to a best-in-class, editorial standard. You'll be the person who takes our brand from good to unmistakably premium: sponsorship decks that make a $50K commitment feel obvious, program brochures that read like a magazine, and social content that stops the scroll.



We already have a strong point of view and existing brand systems across three channels. What we need is someone with the taste and craft to push the execution further than we can take it ourselves, and enough range to move fluidly between polished investor-facing decks and punchy, modern social content.



About Us



FounderSquare (FSQ) and Global Founder Index are sister brands under FounderSquare LLC. Founder Index is a quarterly founder discovery and recognition program, currently spanning 15 founder communities and reaching 250,000+ founders. Each of the first three quarters spotlights a Top 26 founders, culminating in a Q4 Gala Award Summit in Manhattan that names the Top 26 of the year, six category winners, and Founder of the Year. The program is backed by family offices and VCs, Microsoft, and PwC sitting on the independent selection committee. The Gala itself is produced by the same team behind the WSJ's annual galas.



What You'll Work On



- Sponsorship and investor-facing decks for our corporate partners program

- Program brochures for each quarterly edition, at or above the production quality of our current ones

- Visual content for our social channels across a few distinct brand identities

- Editorial-style portraits and features for program participants

- Ad hoc marketing and sales collateral as the program grows (media kits, one-pagers, event signage, etc.)



 What We're Looking For



- A portfolio that shows premium, editorial-grade design work - think luxury brand collateral, high-end event or media branding, or investor/sponsorship materials, not template-driven marketing design

- Strong typography and layout instincts; comfortable designing for print-quality brochures as well as social-first formats

- Experience building or working within multiple brand systems without losing consistency

- Fluency in Figma and/or Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop)

- Ability to take a rough brief from a solo founder and turn it into something polished, fast, with minimal back-and-forth

- Comfortable working independently, flexible-hours basis



Nice to Have



- Experience designing for finance, venture, or luxury/hospitality brands

- Familiarity with HTML/CSS-based rendering pipelines for producing static image assets

- Light motion or animation skills (GIFs, animated carousels)





Engagement



Part-time / fractional, ongoing basis with flexible hours built around deliverable deadlines each quarter (heavier workload around each Top 26 announcement and the Q4 Gala). Remote-friendly.



To Apply



Please send a portfolio or work samples, particularly anything in the brochure, sponsorship deck, or premium brand collateral space, along with your typical rate structure for fractional/part-time engagements.

title: Klaviyo Email Copywriter & Campaign Manager
description:
Read this part first



You get 5% of every euro of revenue Klaviyo attributes to the
s you write and send. Uncapped. Forever, for as long as you're the one running the account.



This job offer is commission based only.



If the
s you write do €50,000 in a month, you make €2,500. If they do €150,000, you make €7,500. Nobody caps you, nobody renegotiates you down, and nobody takes the account away from you because you got too expensive.



Who we are



We're a DTC health and beauty brand selling to women & men aged 45–75. 



Cold traffic from Meta into direct response funnels, advertorials, VSLs, long-form sales pages. 

We've been running since 2023 with multiple products live across several markets.



We are a direct response shop. Everything is measured. Nothing is decorative. Our copy has a job and the job is revenue.



The list is there. The traffic is there. The products convert.
 is currently the most underworked asset we own, which is exactly why I'm willing to hand 5% of it to the right person instead of squeezing it myself.



What you'll actually do



Daily campaigns. You write and send to the list every day. Not "a few times a week when there's a promo." Daily. Story
s, offer
s, curiosity
s, urgency
s, re-engagement
s, plain-text
s that read like a message from a friend. You own the calendar.



Flows. You own and continuously improve the full Klaviyo flow architecture — welcome series, abandoned cart, abandoned checkout, browse abandonment, post-purchase, subscription retention, winback. Not "set it and forget it." Tested, iterated, rewritten.



Segmentation and list health. 



Testing Subject lines, offers, angles, send times. 

You bring hypotheses, you run the tests, you report what won.



Reporting. A short weekly number: revenue generated, open/click rates, what you tested, what you're shipping next week.



The copy standard



I'm a direct response copywriter myself. I will read your
s closely and I will tell you exactly what's wrong with them.



What I want:



Subject lines built on curiosity, specificity, or self-interest, not clever wordplay

s written to one person, not to a list

Story and mechanism-driven copy, not "Shop our bestsellers ????"

One idea per
, one clear CTA

Copy that respects that our customer is 45–75, not a 24-year-old on TikTok

Voice-of-customer language, pulled from reviews and support tickets, not invented in your head



What I don't want:



Template
s with a product grid and a discount code

ChatGPT output pasted in with a hero image on top

"Hi [First Name], hope you're having a great week!"

s that could be sent by any brand in any category



If you know Schwartz's awareness levels and can tell me which stage a given
 is written for, we will get along fine.



Requirements



Proven Klaviyo experience. You've owned an account, not just "helped with
."

Native or near-native English writing. Your
s go out unedited. If I have to rewrite them, the arrangement doesn't work for either of us.

Direct response background. Health, beauty, supplements, or info products preferred. If your experience is fashion drops and B2B newsletters, this will be a hard adjustment.

You can write fast. Daily sending means daily writing. If a single
 takes you four hours, the math doesn't work for you.

You're comfortable with commission-only. You believe in your own copy enough to bet on it.

Reliable internet and daily availability.
s don't skip days.



How to apply



Send your application with all three of these.

Applications missing any of them get archived without a reply.



1. Klaviyo attribution screenshots. Screenshots from inside Klaviyo showing revenue you generated. Campaign performance, flow performance, or the account overview. Blur the client name if you need to — I don't need to know who they are, I need to see the numbers are real. Include the date range.



2. Three
s you wrote. Actual sent
s, not spec work. One campaign, one flow
, and one of your choice. Tell me in one line what each one was supposed to do and whether it did it.



3. Your best subject line and your worst. With the open rates. I want to see that you track this and that you're honest about what flopped.





The process



I review applications and reply to the ones that clear the bar.

Short call to talk through the account, the products, and the numbers.

You write two campaign
s on a real product. Paid at the commission rate if we send them.

If they perform, you take the account and start the 5%.



No unpaid test that runs for three weeks. 

Two
s, we send them, you get paid on what they earn.

title: Executive Assistant & Operations Coordinator
description:
## Executive Assistant & Operations Coordinator



SEND Me Your INTRO VIDEEO explaining your detailed experience and work processes



**Full-Time Remote Position**



I am looking for a reliable and highly organized Virtual Assistant who can provide direct executive and operational support to me and my business.



I work in a fast-paced environment and often communicate through brief messages, screenshots, or voice notes. The ideal candidate must be able to understand these instructions, identify the required action, ask for any missing information, and follow each task through to completion.



You will serve as an important link between me, my internal team, drivers, customers, and other stakeholders. This is a full-time position with the opportunity to take on additional responsibilities as trust and familiarity with the business grow.



### Primary Responsibilities



* Provide direct executive and administrative support.

* Interpret messages, screenshots, voice notes, and informal instructions and turn them into clear, actionable tasks.

* Maintain an accurate and prioritized task list.

* Track deadlines, reminders, and follow-ups until each item is fully completed.

* Prepare professional
s, messages, updates, and internal communications on my behalf.

* Coordinate with internal team members to ensure instructions are received, understood, and completed.

* Assist with driver and dispatch coordination, including confirming assignments, reporting times, locations, and schedule changes.

* Follow up with drivers and dispatch personnel and escalate urgent concerns when necessary.

* Help coordinate backup arrangements when a driver becomes unavailable.

* Communicate professionally with customers regarding schedule changes, delays, or operational concerns.

* Document i
 and follow up to ensure issues are properly resolved.

* Create and maintain task trackers, checklists, workflows, and standard operating procedures.

* Provide concise progress updates and an end-of-day report covering completed tasks, outstanding items, potential risks, and decisions needed.

title: Operations Lead
description:
Operations Leader – UK Property & Lettings



Remote | Philippines | Flexible hours with potential to grow



I run a growing UK property development and lettings business and I’m looking for a highly capable Operations Manager / player-manager to help run the day-to-day operation.



This isn’t a traditional VA role.



I’m looking for someone who can manage people AND get things done themselves. Someone who sees a problem, takes ownership and finds the solution rather than simply escalating it to me.



What you’ll do



* Manage and hold our existing remote team accountable.

* Drive priorities through to completion.

* Oversee property refurbishments, budgets, timelines and funding.

* Oversee lettings operations including occupancy, arrears, maintenance and compliance.

* Track cash flow, forecasts and KPIs.

* Identify and remove operational bottlenecks.

* Build and improve systems, processes and SOPs.

* Personally execute tasks when needed.

* Gradually remove the founder from day-to-day operations.



Who I’m looking for



You’ll be organised, proactive and commercially minded with excellent English.



You should be comfortable with people, numbers, spreadsheets, projects and problem-solving.



You don’t wait to be told what to do. You take an outcome, work out what needs to happen and make it happen.



Property experience is useful, but operational ability matters more.



What success looks like



30 days: Understand the business, team and projects. Get into the detail, clear bottlenecks and start taking operational work away from me.



60 days: Own the operating rhythm, manage the team, improve systems/KPIs and drive projects through without me chasing.



90 days: The business is noticeably less founder-dependent. You run day-to-day operations, solve routine problems and escalate only genuine strategic decisions.



This remains a player-manager role — you’ll lead the team but still roll your sleeves up when something needs doing.



Hours



I’m flexible for the right person.



I’m more interested in output, ownership and capability than somebody sitting at a desk for a fixed number of hours.



The role could start on reduced/flexible hours and grow as you take on more responsibility.



How to apply



Start your application with:



FOUNDER FREEDOM



Then send:



1. Your CV.

2. A 2–3 minute introduction video.

3. One example of an operational problem you personally solved.

4. One example of a process or system you improved.

5. Your expected monthly salary/rate and preferred working hours.



Please don’t use AI to write your answers. I want to understand how you think and communicate.

Ensure processes remain simple and practical for field staff to follow.

Check that required forms, checklists, photos, notes and documentation are being completed.



Follow up with staff when information or documentation is missing.

Monitor whether staff are following company procedures.



Escalate ongoing issues to management where required.



Help create accountability around company systems without requiring constant involvement from the business owner.



SOP and Documentation Development

Document how AroFlo workflows and systems operate.



Create simple guides and instructions for staff.



Maintain and update company procedures as systems evolve.

Staff Training and Support

Create simple training material where required.



Identify where staff are struggling with the system and improve either the training or the process.



Reporting and Management Support



Create simple reports for management showing whether systems are being followed.



Identify incomplete jobs, missing documentation and outstanding actions.



Assist with reporting relating to labour, job progress, compliance and other business information.



Provide regular updates on system performance and areas requiring improvement.



Systems and Process Improvement



Continuously look for opportunities to improve business systems.



Assist with integrations between AroFlo and other software where possible.



Explore automation opportunities that reduce repetitive administration.



Recommend improvements that save management and field staff time.



Help create a more organised, systemised and scalable business.



Broader Business Support



Once AroFlo is operating effectively, the role will expand into other areas of the business, which may include:



General systems administration.



Internal compliance and staff follow-up.



Reporting and data management.



Workflow improvement.



Process documentation.



Business administration.



Automation and software improvement.



Other operational support as the business continues to grow.



Skills and Qualifications



Strong written and spoken English.



Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.



Strong computer and software skills.



Ability to learn new software quickly.



Experience working with business systems, CRMs, job management software or project management platforms.



Strong process-thinking and problem-solving ability.



Ability to work independently without requiring constant direction.



Comfortable following up with staff and holding people accountable for completing required tasks.



Ability to document processes clearly and simply.



Strong communication skills.



Highly Regarded



Previous AroFlo experience.



Experience with construction, trades or field-service businesses.



Experience implementing job management software.



Experience creating SOPs, workflows and checklists.



Experience with automation tools such as Zapier or Make.



Experience with reporting and business process improvement.



What We Are Looking For

We want someone who can take ownership of the systems side of the business.



If you notice that a process is not working properly, we want you to investigate why and help improve it.



If field staff are repeatedly missing something onsite, we want you to help create a process, checklist or system that prevents the problem.



The goal is for you to become the person responsible for ensuring our systems are built properly, followed by the team and continuously improved.



What We Offer

Direct access to the business owner and management team.



Significant responsibility and ownership of company systems.



Opportunity to develop your skills in systems, automation and business operations.



Salary review based on performance and capability.



Opportunity for the role to expand as the business grows.



A position where your work can have a direct impact on how the company operates.

Your CV/resume.

Capped at six accounts, so up to $2,500/month

5+ years managing social accounts professionally

Reliable internet, backup power arrangement

Monday to Friday, with overlap into our hours

The 10 accounts you have managed, with the 3 references



Live links plus before and after on 3 of them



Three shorts you personally cut, with a line on what the raw footage looked like

Your daily-use software



How much direction do you need, and where do you run independently?



Your cadence for scripts, calendar and posting, and what you need from a client weekly



What you track, how often the client sees it, what a monthly report looks like



Your rate and what is included



One concrete idea for a personal brand account in the women's self-development space

Process



Application review, 30-minute video interview, reference calls, paid trial (a test month of strategy with reasoning plus shorts you cut yourself, paid regardless of outcome),



The bigger picture:



We are not filling a seat. We are looking for the person who runs content here.



You are the first strategy hire. Everything after you gets built around the standard you set. The editors we hire report into your direction, work to your briefs, and answer to your review.



You will produce heavily at the start. That is intentional. You cannot direct a team to a standard you have not personally set. But the trajectory is off the timeline and into leadership: creative direction across every account, quality control, hiring and training the editors under you, and building the systems the team runs on.



If it works, we grow this together. Compensation, scope and title all move with what you build.



If you want to be handed briefs, this is not it. If you want to own the function, read on.

title: PODCAST PRODUCER & GUEST BOOKER
description:
PART-TIME PODCAST PRODUCER & GUEST BOOKER  

Remote | Philippines-Based | 



We are seeking a highly organised and resourceful podcast producer to help relaunch and grow a Singapore-based, expert-led interview podcast.



The podcast will feature intelligent and engaging conversations with experts and notable personalities in areas such as health, aesthetics, women’s wellness, menopause, longevity, fitness, entrepreneurship and personal development.



We plan to release approximately four episodes per month.



This is primarily a research, guest-booking and production-management position. Video and audio editing will be handled by a separate editor.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Guest Research and Booking



• Identify credible, interesting and relevant potential guests  

• Research guests before recommending them  

• Explain why each proposed guest would suit the podcast  

• Find fresh interview angles rather than repeating topics the guest has discussed many times  

• Draft personalised guest invitations and follow-up messages  

• Manage the guest pipeline and follow-up schedule  

• Coordinate recording dates, confirmations and reminders  

• Maintain professional and courteous communication with guests and their representatives



Episode Preparation



• Research each confirmed guest thoroughly  

• Review the guest’s previous interviews, work and public content  

• Prepare a concise episode briefing document for the host  

• Develop a clear narrative direction for each conversation  

• Prepare approximately 10–15 thoughtful interview questions  

• Write a short guest introduction and confirm the accuracy of the guest’s biography  

• Identify sensitive subjects or factual issues the host should know about  

• Suggest potential episode titles, thumbnail hooks and short-form content angles



Production Coordination



• Maintain the podcast calendar and production tracker  

• Coordinate with the host, guest, studio and remote editor  

• Ensure recording information and guest requirements are confirmed  

• Transfer briefs, notes and files to the relevant team members  

• Monitor editing, approval and publishing deadlines  

• Check that names, professional titles and episode information are accurate  

• Prepare episode descriptions, chapter headings and publishing notes  

• Maintain organised Google Drive folders and production records



Growth and Review



• Monitor episode and short-form content performance  

• Prepare a simple monthly summary of results  

• Identify which guests, subjects and content angles perform best  

• Suggest improvements based on audience response



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND QUALITIES



• At least two years of relevant experience in podcast production, guest booking, journalism, research, public relations, executive assistance or content production  

• Excellent written and spoken English  

• Strong research and fact-checking ability  

• Ability to write warm, professional and personalised outreach messages  

• Good judgement when dealing with doctors, executives, academics, public figures and their representatives  

• Highly organised and dependable  

• Able to work independently and meet deadlines  

• Comfortable using Google Drive, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Zoom and project-management tools  

• Reliable internet connection  

• Available for occasional meetings and guest coordination during Singapore business hours



Singapore and the Philippines are in the same time zone.



IMPORTANT STANDARDS



Some episodes will involve medical and health-related subjects. Information must be obtained from credible sources and carefully fact-checked.



AI tools may be used to assist with research and organisation, but automatically generated information must never be submitted without human review and source verification.



All guest outreach and sensitive communication must be approved before being sent until the producer has been authorised to manage these communications independently.



The successful applicant must maintain strict confidentiality. The host’s identity and further details about the podcast will be disclosed to shortlisted candidates.



WORKLOAD AND COMPENSATION



• Part-time remote position  

• Approximately 10 hours per week on average  

• Approximately two to four episodes per month  

• Long-term opportunity  

• Compensation will be reviewed if the workload regularly exceeds four episodes per month



There will be an initial trial assignment . The trial will involve researching a potential guest and preparing a complete episode proposal and interview brief. It will not require contacting the guest.



HOW TO APPLY



Please provide:



1. A concise introduction explaining your relevant experience  

2. Links to podcasts, interviews or content projects you have helped produce  

3. A clear explanation of your personal contribution to each project  

4. A sample research brief, interview outline or guest proposal, if available  

5. Details of any guest-booking or outreach experience  

6. Your usual working hours and availability  

7. Your expected monthly compensation  

8. The word “Chai” at the beginning of your application to confirm that you have read the complete advertisement



Generic or automatically generated applications that do not address the requirements above will not be considered.

description:
REMOTE VIDEO & AUDIO PODCAST EDITOR  

Freelance | Philippines-Based | Four Episodes per Month



We are a Singapore-based medical and wellness brand seeking an experienced video and audio editor for an ongoing interview podcast.



Each podcast episode consists of approximately 60–90 minutes of conversation, usually involving two or three speakers. Recordings may include footage from multiple cameras and separate audio tracks.



We expect to produce four podcast episodes per month.



The finished content should feel polished, intelligent, modern and premium. We prefer clean, restrained editing rather than excessive animations, distracting effects or gimmicky social-media styling.



DELIVERABLES FOR EACH PODCAST EPISODE



• One professionally edited 60–90-minute YouTube episode  

• Synchronisation of multicamera footage and separate audio tracks  

• Natural camera changes based on the person speaking and the flow of the conversation  

• One mastered audio-only podcast file  

• Five to six vertical YouTube Shorts selected from the strongest moments in the episode  

• Accurate, professionally formatted captions for every Short  

• Clean branded opening, closing and speaker-name graphics  

• Balanced dialogue volume, noise reduction, EQ and audio mastering  

• Natural, flattering and consistent colour correction  

• Removal of mistakes, long pauses, technical interruptions and unnecessary repetition  

• Three high-resolution stills suitable for use in episode thumbnails  

• Correctly named and organised final files  

• Complete editable project and source files upon request



The five to six Shorts should not simply be random extracts. The editor must identify compelling, useful or surprising moments that can stand alone and encourage viewers to watch the full conversation.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Long-Form Podcast Editing



• Synchronise footage from multiple cameras and audio sources  

• Select appropriate camera angles for conversations involving two or three speakers  

• Maintain natural pacing while removing obvious errors and unnecessary pauses  

• Remove excessive filler words where this can be done without making the conversation sound unnatural  

• Preserve the intelligence and substance of the discussion  

• Use close-ups, wide shots and reaction shots appropriately  

• Apply the established podcast graphics, fonts, colours and visual style  

• Correct audio inconsistencies between different speakers  

• Correct colour and maintain natural, flattering skin tones  

• Check the entire episode before delivery for audio, visual, spelling and export errors



YouTube Shorts



• Identify five to six strong moments from every episode  

• Edit each selection into an engaging vertical video  

• Create a strong opening hook based on what was genuinely said  

• Use accurate and readable captions  

• Reframe footage correctly for vertical viewing  

• Keep speaker faces and important visual information within the safe viewing area  

• Avoid misleading hooks, exaggerated claims or removing statements from their proper context  

• Export each Short in the correct vertical format for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikTok



Audio Editing



• Clean and balance all dialogue tracks  

• Reduce background noise, echo, clicks and other distractions where possible  

• Apply appropriate EQ, compression and loudness levels  

• Ensure that all speakers remain clear and easy to understand  

• Export a properly mastered audio-only version suitable for podcast platforms



MEDICAL AND WELLNESS CONTENT STANDARDS



The podcast discusses medical, aesthetic, health and wellness subjects. Accuracy is essential.



• Medical terminology in captions and graphics must be spelled correctly  

• Names, professional titles, medications, treatments and scientific terms must not be guessed  

• Any uncertain terminology must be flagged for confirmation  

• Statements must not be edited in a way that changes their original medical meaning  

• Short-form hooks must not exaggerate, sensationalise or misrepresent what the speaker said



AI tools may be used to accelerate transcription, captioning and clip identification, but every output must be reviewed and corrected manually.



TURNAROUND REQUIREMENTS



Prompt and reliable delivery is essential because we intend to publish approximately one full episode every week.



For each episode:



• Confirm receipt of all files within 12 hours  

• Report missing, damaged or unusable files immediately  

• Deliver the first full-length edit within four working days  

• Deliver the five to six Shorts and complete content package within six working days  

• Return reasonable revisions within two working days  

• Complete up to two reasonable revision rounds per episode



Applicants should only apply if they have sufficient weekly capacity to meet these deadlines consistently.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

• Demonstrable experience editing long-form interviews, podcasts or multicamera conversations

title: PC Developer Claude Code
description:
Interesting project to interact with windows from a PC application.



Do you have experience with?:



Claude Code

Google Drive API

Google Calendar



Project Top Level Query:



how do i go about using AI to build an install pc program to pretend to be a person enter data into windows of another pc program running on the same desktop



Building this is basically classic desktop automation / RPA (robotic process automation), and it's a solved problem — AI (like this session or Claude Code on your own machine) is genuinely useful for writing the glue code once you've identified the right approach. Here's how I'd think about it.



Two fundamentally different techniques, pick based on the target app:



1. Accessibility/UI Automation API — the robust option. Windows exposes a UI Automation (UIA) tree for most native apps (and even many Electron/Java/legacy Win32 apps), which lets you find a specific text box, button, or dropdown by its name/automation ID and set its value or send keystrokes directly, without needing pixel coordinates. In Python this is pywinauto (wraps both UIA and the older Win32 API); 
 it's FlaUI; AutoHotkey can also address controls this way if the app cooperates.



2. Simulated input / image matching — the fallback for apps that don't expose a usable control tree (old terminal emulators, some games, custom-drawn UIs). Here you move the mouse and send keystrokes as if a person were doing it, using screen coordinates or template-matching (pyautogui, SikuliX, OpenCV). It's more fragile — breaks if a window moves or resizes — but it works on literally anything you can see.



The actual workflow:



• First, inspect the target program's window. Use Accessibility Insights for Windows (free, from Microsoft) or the older inspect.exe from the Windows SDK to click on each field you need to fill and see its automation ID, name, and control type. This tells you which of the two techniques above will work — if fields show up with real names/IDs, go the UIA route.

• Feed those control names/IDs (or screenshots, if you're going the image-matching route) to an AI coding assistant and have it write the automation script: find the window by title/class, locate each control, set its value or send keystrokes, handle timing (waiting for the window/dialog to actually be ready before typing).

• Iterate by actually running it against the real app — automation scripts against GUIs almost always need a few rounds of "it clicked before the dialog opened" type fixes.

• If you want typing to look human-paced rather than instantaneous, add small randomized delays between keystrokes 

• (pywinauto's .type_keys() and pyautogui.write(interval=...) both support this natively).

One thing worth checking before you build this: if the target program has licensing terms or built-in protections that specifically prohibit automated/bot input (some enterprise, exam, or ticketing software does this to stop exactly this kind of automation), that's worth reading first — the technique itself is standard, but whether it's allowed depends on that specific app's terms.

title: Senior Electrical Designer / EPLAN Engineer
description:
Please only apply if you meet these key requirements:



1. You have your own licensed copy of EPLAN or equivalent professional electrical design software.

2. You have significant experience designing industrial automation/control panels, not just electrical drafting.

3. You can design and size a panel independently, rather than requiring an engineer to design it for you.

4. You understand modern PLC automation including PROFINET, IO-Link, remote I/O, VSDs, instrumentation and safety circuits.

5. You can provide examples of electrical drawings you have personally produced.



PTI Pacific is an Australian engineering company designing and manufacturing automated process equipment for the food, beverage and industrial sectors.



We are looking for an experienced electrical engineer/designer to support us as an hourly contractor on a project-by-project basis. This is not a full-time position at this stage, it will be project based. 



You will produce complete, professional electrical drawing packages for our machinery and process skids. We will provide examples of our existing projects and expect new drawings to follow a similar modern, high-quality colour format.



Typical scope includes:



* Electrical schematics and control-panel layouts

* 3-phase power distribution, circuit protection and component sizing

* 24 VDC control systems and power supplies

* Siemens PLCs, distributed/remote I/O and HMI systems

* PROFINET and industrial Ethernet networks

* IO-Link masters, sensors and actuators

* VSD/VFD motor circuits and motor protection

* Safety relays and machine safety circuits

* Process instrumentation, analogue and digital I/O

* Terminal plans, cable schedules, BOMs and device identification

* Panel load calculations and component selection

* Drawing revisions and as-built documentation



Our equipment commonly uses industrial brands such as Siemens, IFM, SMC, Weidmüller, Bürkert and Alfa Laval



You must be experienced enough to work autonomously from information such as P&IDs, I/O lists, equipment datasheets, project specifications and our previous drawings. We are looking for someone capable of electrical design as well as drafting.



Experience with Australian electrical standards, particularly AS/NZS 3000, and machinery/control-panel design is strongly preferred.



This role would suit an experienced electrical engineer, industrial electrician, automation engineer or senior electrical designer with practical control-panel experience.



When applying, please include: 

* your electrical/automation experience

* software and version you use and confirmation that you have your own license

* examples of drawings you personally produced

* experience with Siemens/PROFINET/IO-Link; Australian standards experience

* Expected hourly USD rate; and typical weekly availability
