title: Social Media Content & Growth Specialist
description:
Full-Time Remote – Philippines



MTLI Group is looking for a highly creative, analytical, fast-moving Social Media Growth, Virality & Content Specialist to help us build a large organic audience across multiple social media platforms.



This is NOT a traditional social media coordinator role.



The goal of this position is simple:



Create large volumes of content, aggressively test what works, generate multiple viral or breakout videos every month, and consistently grow followers, reach, traffic, and engagement across all of our social accounts.



We expect approximately 300 pieces of content per week across our network of accounts and platforms.



You will be responsible for the full content cycle:



Research → Ideas → Creation → Editing → Clipping → Design → Posting → Testing → Analytics → Optimization → Repurposing



Primary Goal: Growth & Virality



Your job is not simply to keep our social accounts active.



Your job is to help them grow.



We want someone who is obsessed with:



• Views

• Reach

• Watch time

• Retention

• Shares

• Saves

• Comments

• Followers

• Profile visits

• Website traffic

• Viral and breakout content



Every week you should be studying what is working and using that information to make the next round of content better.



Viral Content Expectations



We want to consistently produce content capable of breaking out beyond our existing audience.



Our target is to generate multiple viral or high-performing videos every month across our network of accounts.



You should understand:



• Strong first-second hooks

• Pattern interrupts

• Curiosity gaps

• Storytelling

• Retention editing

• Watch-time optimization

• Looping

• Thumbnail and title psychology

• Controversial or debate-driven hooks where appropriate

• Educational hooks

• Transformation content

• Before-and-after content

• Satisfying industrial footage

• Trend adaptation

• Platform-native editing



You should be able to look at analytics and explain WHY a video worked or failed.



300 Pieces of Content Per Week



Our content operation is built around volume and intelligent repurposing.



Target:



Approximately 300 finished content assets per week.



This may include:



• TikToks

• Instagram Reels

• YouTube Shorts

•
 Reels

• LinkedIn videos

• Graphics

• Carousels

• Photo posts

• Before-and-after posts

• Stories

• Project highlights

• Recruitment posts

• Educational content

• Leadership content

• Thumbnails

• Alternate hooks

• Alternate edits

• Platform-specific versions



300 pieces does not mean 300 completely unique ideas.



A strong piece of footage should be multiplied into many different assets.



For example:



One warehouse automation project could become:



10 short-form clips



5 different hooks



3 different edits of the strongest clip



Before-and-after content



Project statistics



Educational clips



A carousel



Several graphics



Stories



Recruitment content



Customer-proof content



Different platform versions



Your job is to maximize the value of every piece of content we capture.



Content Ideation



You will be expected to create new ideas every week without waiting for management to tell you what to post.



Develop content around:



• Industrial construction

• Warehouse automation

• Racking

• Conveyor systems

• Robotics

• Material handling

• Large warehouses

• Manufacturing

• Logistics

• Construction

• Skilled trades

• Equipment

• Project transformations

• Business growth

• Leadership

• Recruiting

• Behind-the-scenes content



We want content that is interesting even to people who do not work in construction.



Think:



“How do we make a massive warehouse installation interesting enough that someone stops scrolling?”



Market & Viral Research



Research social media daily.



Study:



• Competitors

• Construction creators

• Business creators

• Manufacturing accounts

• Logistics accounts

• Engineering accounts

• Viral industrial videos

• TikTok trends

• YouTube Shorts trends

• Instagram trends

• Emerging formats

• Hooks

• Editing styles

• Topics gaining traction



Maintain a content research database containing winning examples and ideas we can adapt.



We expect you to bring recommendations to us, not the other way around.



Video Editing & Clipping



You will edit raw footage into high-retention content.



This includes:



• Strong hooks in the first 1–3 seconds

• Fast pacing

• Captions

• Subtitles

• Sound effects

• Music

• B-roll

• Zooms

• Graphics

• Pattern interrupts

• Calls to action

• Retention-focused editing



You should be comfortable testing multiple versions of the same video.



If a concept has potential, we may create:



Hook A

Hook B

Hook C



and test all three.



Graphic Design



You will also create:



• Social media graphics

• LinkedIn carousels

• Infographics

• Before-and-after graphics

• Project statistics

• Recruitment graphics

• Customer proof

• Case studies

• Thumbnails

• Story graphics

• Promotional creative



Multi-Account Growth



We will operate multiple accounts across:



• TikTok

• Instagram

• YouTube

•

• LinkedIn

• X

• Other relevant platforms



These may include:



• Main MTLI corporate accounts

• Industry-specific accounts

• Racking accounts

• Automation accounts

• Construction accounts

• Recruitment accounts

• Regional accounts

• Leadership / founder content

• Clipping-style accounts



Your responsibility is to help grow the entire network.



Core KPIs

Content Production



300 finished content assets per week



Viral / Breakout Content



Goal:



Multiple breakout or viral-performing videos every month across the account network.



Because platform distribution cannot be guaranteed, performance will be evaluated based on repeated testing, breakout frequency, reach, retention, and improvement over time.



Follower Growth



Every assigned account should show measurable follower growth.



We will track:



Net new followers per week

Net new followers per month

Follower growth percentage

Cost of content production per follower gained



Total Reach



Increase total monthly organic reach across the account network.



Views



Increase total monthly video views.



Watch Time



Improve average watch time and completion rate.



Engagement



Increase:



• Shares

• Saves

• Comments

• Likes

• Reposts



Shares and saves will be especially important because they indicate content people actually value.



Traffic



Increase:



• Profile visits

• Website visits

• Direct inquiries

• Social-attributed leads



Testing Volume



Continuously test:



• Hooks

• Titles

• Thumbnails

• Lengths

• Editing styles

• Posting times

• Topics

• Calls to action



Winning Content Replication



Every winning piece of content should generate additional variations.



If something works, we do not move on immediately.



We double down on it.



Weekly Reporting



Each week you will provide a report showing:



• Total pieces created

• Total pieces posted

• Views by platform

• Top 10 pieces of content

• Follower growth

• Total reach

• Engagement

• Shares

• Saves

• Website traffic

• Viral / breakout posts

• Best-performing hooks

• Worst-performing posts

• What you learned

• What you will test next week



We want decisions based on data.



Who We Want



We want someone who is:



• Obsessed with social media growth

• Extremely creative

• Extremely fast

• Competitive

• Data-driven

• Comfortable testing constantly

• Comfortable failing and trying again

• Strong at video editing

• Strong at graphic design

• Strong at content research

• Strong at spotting trends

• Able to manage a high content volume

• Capable of working independently



You should naturally spend time studying why content goes viral.



Preferred Experience



We strongly prefer candidates who have previously:



• Grown TikTok accounts

• Grown Instagram accounts

• Grown YouTube Shorts accounts

• Operated clipping pages

• Operated theme pages

• Managed high-volume content accounts

• Generated videos with 100K+ views

• Generated videos with 500K+ views

• Generated videos with 1M+ views

• Built audiences organically



We care about evidence.



Show us what you have actually grown.



Application Requirements



Please send:



Resume

Portfolio

Links to accounts you personally managed

Current follower count and starting follower count for accounts you grew

Screenshots or links showing your top-performing videos

Your highest-viewed video

Examples of videos you personally edited

Examples of graphics you personally created

Your experience with clipping accounts

Your experience creating viral content

Your average weekly content output

Editing software you use

Graphic design software you use

AI tools you use

Expected monthly salary in PHP

Application Question



Start your application with:



“I BUILD CONTENT FOR GROWTH, NOT JUST POSTING.”



Then answer:



What is the largest account you have personally helped grow, what did you grow it from and to, and what specific actions caused the growth?



Unpaid Practical Test



Shortlisted candidates may receive raw MTLI footage and be asked to:



• Create 10 short-form videos

• Develop at least 3 different hooks for the strongest video

• Create 2 graphics

• Provide 15 new content ideas

• Identify 10 viral content references we could adapt

• Explain which content they believe has the highest viral potential and why

• Build a sample one-week distribution plan



We are looking for someone who can combine creativity, speed, analytics, volume, and experimentation to build a major social media presence.



If you only want to schedule posts, this position is not for you.



If you want to build accounts, chase breakout content, test constantly, and help create millions of impressions, we want to hear from you.

title: PPC Manager – Conversion Tracking Expert (Home Services/Local Services Agency, US Clients)
description:
About Us:

We're a US-based performance marketing agency running paid media for home services and local service businesses. We manage six-figure monthly ad spend across Google and Meta, and conversion tracking accuracy is the backbone of everything we do → client billing, optimization, and reporting all depend on it. We're looking for someone who can run full campaigns end-to-end AND who lives and breathes attribution → not someone who "can figure it out."



If you know less about call tracking, GTM, and attribution than we do, you're not the right fit. We need an expert.



What You'll Own:

- Full-cycle campaign management, A-Z — keyword research, campaign structure/build, ad copy, bid strategy, ongoing optimization across multiple live client accounts simultaneously

- Conversion tracking as the foundation → CallRail (dynamic number insertion, call swapping), Google Tag Manager, click-to-call and form conversion attribution, remarketing pixels → set up correctly before spend decisions are trusted

- Historical data analysis → auditing account history to understand what's working, what's wasted spend, and what needs to change before you touch anything

- Call quality review → actually listening to recorded calls to judge lead quality, not just counting conversions

Expert-level reporting — building and presenting clear performance reports, both internally to our team and directly to clients on calls, explaining why numbers moved, not just what they are

- Client communication → comfortable on calls explaining strategy, defending decisions, and handling pushback

- Full accountability →you own outcomes on your accounts, not just tasks on a list

- Fast-paced, multi-account context switching → pivoting strategy quickly when a campaign underperforms or a client's business changes, managing several accounts at once without dropping balls



You Must Be Able To Answer These Without Googling:

- Explain the difference between GA4 event-based conversions and Google Ads conversion actions

- Walk through how you'd diagnose a call that isn't showing up in CallRail

- Explain dynamic number insertion and why swap pools matter

- Describe how you'd set up a GTM trigger to fire a Meta Pixel event only on a form's "thank you" confirmation, not on page load

- Explain the difference between click-through and view-through attribution and why it matters for phone-heavy verticals

Requirements

- Proven, hands-on experience with CallRail (not "familiar with" → actually configured it)

- Proven, hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager — can build containers from scratch

- Direct experience running paid media for a US-based home services company (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, painting, etc.) → this is not negotiable



**Strong English communication, comfortable on video calls with US-based team and clients**



Can show real work → screen recordings, case studies, or a live audit of a sample account during interview. 



Screening Process (heads up, this is real):

- Short written questionnaire (tracking/attribution scenarios, not generic PPC trivia)

- Live screen-share task: audit a sample GTM container or CallRail setup and tell us what's broken

- Paid trial project before any ongoing commitment



What We Don't Want:

- "I can manage campaigns" with no tracking depth

- Agencies/subcontractors — we need one accountable person

- Anyone who can't speak specifically to call attribution in a phone-heavy vertical

 (free) for reviews and revisions

gameranx

title: NDIS rostering coordinator
description:
## Job Title



NDIS Rostering Coordinator — Disability Support & Workforce Scheduling



## Role Type



Remote / Offshore

Full-time

Australian healthcare and disability support business



## About the Role



We are looking for a highly organised and proactive NDIS Rostering Coordinator to support the day-to-day scheduling of disability support workers and client services across our growing Australian NDIS and care services business.



This role is ideal for someone with experience in rostering, scheduling, workforce coordination, disability support administration, healthcare administration or virtual operations support.



You will help ensure clients receive the right support, at the right time, with the right staff member. The role requires strong attention to detail, clear communication, fast follow-up and the ability to manage changes in a busy service environment.



You will work closely with care managers, support workers and management to coordinate shifts, update rosters, track staff availability, manage changes and maintain accurate records.



## Key Responsibilities



### Rostering & Scheduling



Create, update and maintain staff rosters



Allocate support workers to client shifts based on availability, location, skills and client needs



Monitor upcoming shifts and identify gaps or coverage issues



Assist with last-minute roster changes, cancellations and staff replacements



Update shift details accurately in the rostering system



Ensure rosters are communicated clearly to support workers and relevant managers



### Staff & Client Coordination



Communicate with support workers regarding shift confirmations, changes and availability



Follow up with staff who have not confirmed shifts or submitted required information



Support care managers with client scheduling needs



Escalate urgent issues, missed shifts, complaints or service risks to management



Help ensure clients receive consistent and reliable support



Maintain professional communication with staff, clients and internal teams



### Compliance & Administration



Maintain accurate records of shifts, staff availability and service changes



Assist with tracking staff documents, training, qualifications and compliance requirements



Support incident, cancellation and shift note follow-ups where required



Assist with timesheet checks and roster accuracy before payroll or invoicing



Help maintain clean and organised client and staff records



### Systems & Reporting



Use rostering, CRM, spreadsheet or care management systems to manage information



Prepare simple reports on roster gaps, staff availability, unfilled shifts or service issues



Keep trackers updated and accurate



Identify process improvements to make rostering more efficient



Support management with general operations tasks as required



## What We Are Looking For



Strong written and verbal English communication



Experience in rostering, scheduling, workforce coordination, healthcare administration or virtual assistance



Highly organised and detail-focused



Able to work quickly and calmly when roster changes occur



Confident communicating with staff and managers



Able to follow instructions and escalate issues appropriately



Comfortable using spreadsheets,
, online systems and shared folders



Reliable, proactive and able to work independently



Strong follow-up skills and ability to manage competing priorities



Trustworthy with confidential client and staff information



## Preferred Experience



Previous experience in NDIS, disability support, aged care, healthcare or home care rostering



Experience using ShiftCare, Brevity, CareMaster, Deputy, Employment Hero, Visualcare, Lumary or similar systems



Experience working with Australian businesses or clients



Understanding of support worker scheduling, client preferences and continuity of care



Experience with timesheets, shift notes, cancellations and service delivery administration



Experience working remotely with distributed teams



## What Success Looks Like



In the first 30 days, you will understand our clients, support workers, systems, rostering process and communication standards.



In the first 60 days, you will be confidently updating rosters, confirming shifts, managing staff availability, identifying gaps and supporting care managers with scheduling needs.



In the first 90 days, you will be helping improve rostering accuracy, reduce missed shifts, strengthen communication and create smoother workforce coordination across the business.



## Why Join Us



You will be joining a growing Australian healthcare and disability support business with a strong focus on quality service delivery, responsiveness and operational improvement.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to grow in NDIS operations, rostering, workforce coordination or care administration.



You will work closely with business owners, care managers and operations teams, and play an important role in making sure clients receive reliable and consistent support.



## How to Apply



Please send your resume and a short message outlining:



Your rostering, scheduling or workforce coordination experience



Any NDIS, aged care, disability support or healthcare experience



Systems you have used, especially ShiftCare or similar rostering platforms



Your remote work experience



Your expected monthly salary



Your availability to start

title: Construction Estimator
description:
Senior Construction Estimator / Tendering & Opportunities Specialist



**Remote | Part-Time Initially, Progressing to Full-Time | Australian Commercial Construction



Rapid Modular is a Western Australian commercial construction company delivering modular and traditional construction projects across education, childcare, commercial, government and industrial sectors.



We are seeking a **high-level Senior Construction Estimator / Tendering Specialist** who can not only prepare detailed commercial tenders, but also proactively identify and pursue suitable project opportunities.



This role will commence on a part-time basis, with the clear intention of progressing to a full-time long-term position for the right person based on performance, capability, workload and contribution to the business.



This is a senior, commercially focused role.



We are not looking for a junior estimator, basic quantity take-off operator or someone who waits to be given work.



We need someone who understands Australian commercial construction, can identify suitable tenders in the market, assess whether they are worth pursuing, and then take ownership of preparing a competitive and professional submission.



Key Responsibilities



- Tender Opportunity Search & Pipeline



* Proactively search for suitable Australian commercial construction opportunities

* Monitor tender portals, procurement platforms and industry sources

* Identify projects suitable for Rapid Modular's capabilities and target markets

* Search for opportunities across education, government, childcare, commercial, industrial and modular construction

* Identify upcoming projects before formal tender release where possible

* Research builders, architects, project managers, consultants and potential clients involved in upcoming projects

* Maintain a live tender and opportunity pipeline

* Track EOI dates, closing dates and prequalification opportunities

* Provide initial bid / no-bid recommendations

* Identify subcontract, head contractor and Design & Construct opportunities

* Assist with registrations, expressions of interest and prequalification submissions



We want someone who regularly brings opportunities to management rather than waiting for management to find them.



Estimating & Tendering



* Prepare detailed commercial construction estimates

* Review architectural, structural, civil and services documentation

* Prepare detailed quantity take-offs and BOQs

* Develop complete trade-by-trade scopes

* Prepare subcontractor and supplier RFQs

* Analyse and level subcontractor quotations

* Identify exclusions, qualifications and scope gaps

* Identify construction risks and tender assumptions

* Price preliminaries, supervision, cranage, transport, temporary works and site establishment

* Prepare tender clarifications and qualifications

* Prepare detailed tender breakdowns and cost plans

* Assist with value engineering and alternative construction solutions

* Review tender documentation for commercial risk

* Maintain estimating databases and historical rates

* Assist with tender programmes and construction methodology

* Support preparation of high-quality client-facing tender proposals



Essential Experience



Applicants must have:



* Significant Australian commercial construction estimating experience

* Strong knowledge of Australian construction methods, terminology and procurement

* Previous experience preparing major commercial tenders

* Experience working with or tendering to top-tier or major Australian commercial contractors

* Strong understanding of subcontract trade packages

* Ability to independently review a complete tender package and determine the full scope

* Proven ability to proactively identify tender and construction opportunities

* Familiarity with Australian tender portals and procurement systems

* Strong construction sequencing and methodology knowledge

* Excellent quantity take-off skills

* Experience analysing subcontractor quotations

* Strong Excel capability

* Excellent written English

* High commercial awareness

* Excellent attention to detail



Highly Desirable



Experience with:



* Government procurement

* Education construction

* Childcare facilities

* Commercial offices

* Industrial projects

* Design & Construct

* Modular and prefabricated construction

* Civil and site works

* Services coordination

* TenderLink, VendorPanel, AusTender and similar procurement platforms

* CostX, Cubit, Buildsoft, Bluebeam or similar estimating software

* Expressions of Interest and prequalification submissions

* Tender clarifications, exclusions and departures

* Head contract tender submissions

* Lump sum commercial tenders



The Person We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who thinks commercially, takes ownership and is naturally proactive.



You should be capable of:



* Finding suitable opportunities without being instructed where to look

* Determining whether a tender is genuinely worth pursuing

* Understanding where Rapid Modular may have a competitive advantage

* Identifying missing scope and commercial risk

* Recognising conflicting or incomplete consultant documentation

* Finding trade interface gaps

* Challenging unrealistic allowances

* Identifying site access and logistics risks

* Identifying latent condition and temporary works exposure

* Developing sensible tender qualifications

* Following up subcontractors, suppliers and outstanding information without constant supervision



You must be able to think like a commercial builder and tender manager, not simply a quantity surveyor or take-off operator.



If there is a suitable opportunity in the market, we want you to find it.



Working Arrangement



This position will initially commencepart-time, with hours increasing as the successful candidate demonstrates capability and as our tender and project workload grows.



Our objective is to develop the right candidate into a full-time senior estimating and tendering position within Rapid Modular.



For a strong performer, this role has the potential to grow beyond estimating and contribute directly to tender strategy, procurement, opportunity identification and business growth.



You will have access to work directly with the design team, senior project management and the Director.



How to Apply



Please provide:



1. A brief introduction

2. Your current location

3. Total years of construction estimating experience

4. Details of your Australian construction experience

5. Australian contractors or organisations you have previously worked with

6. Examples of commercial projects you have estimated

7. Typical project values you have worked on

8. Experience preparing top-tier commercial tender submissions

9. Examples of how you have previously identified or sourced new tender opportunities

10. Australian tender portals and procurement platforms you are familiar with

11. Estimating software you are proficient in

12. Your expected hourly and monthly rate

13. Your current availability

14. How many hours per week you can initially commit to the role



Please also provide examples of BOQs, estimating schedules, tender documentation or submissions you have personally prepared, with confidential information removed where necessary.



Please start your application with:



RAPID ESTIMATOR



Applications that do not include this will not be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a video interview and may be required to complete a paid practical estimating and opportunity-identification assessment based on Australian commercial construction.

title: Medical Records Review Specialist — Underwriting Support
description:
This is a clinical medical records review role, not a medical coding position. You will review detailed medical records across different specialties, identify relevant medical conditions and treatments, and prepare clear summaries to support insurance underwriting. Strong clinical judgment and medical knowledge are required. If your experience is primarily medical coding or administrative records processing without hands-on clinical records review, this role is likely not a fit.



About This Role



We are looking for an experienced Medical Records Review Specialist to review and interpret confidential clinical records and support insurance underwriting.



You will review medical documentation across different specialties and disease states, identify important medical information, and summarize findings clearly and accurately.



You will also compare the medical records with information provided by applicants and identify undisclosed conditions, medications, treatments, or other discrepancies.



This role requires strong medical knowledge, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently with confidential information.



What You’ll Do

Review and interpret clinical medical records across multiple specialties and disease states

Read and analyze detailed medical documentation

Prepare concise, structured, and actionable summaries

Identify medical conditions, diagnoses, treatments, and medications

Flag undisclosed conditions, medications, or treatments

Identify discrepancies between medical records and applicant disclosures

Apply medical knowledge to support insurance underwriting decisions

Review medical terminology and clinical information accurately

Handle confidential medical records appropriately

Work independently with minimal supervision

Maintain accuracy while reviewing high volumes of documentation



What We’re Looking For

At least 5 years of hands-on medical records review experience

Strong experience reviewing and interpreting clinical records

Knowledge of medical terminology, diagnoses, treatments, and medications

Experience working across multiple medical specialties

Strong ability to summarize lengthy clinical documentation

Excellent attention to detail

Ability to identify discrepancies and missing information

Strong clinical judgment and analytical skills

Ability to work independently

Ability to handle confidential medical information appropriately

Strong written English communication skills

Ability to work U.S. business hours



Important: This is a clinical judgment role, not a medical coding role. You should be able to understand the medical information in a record and determine what is relevant, rather than simply identify codes or enter data.



Nice to Have

Experience supporting life or health insurance underwriting

Familiarity with U.S. healthcare documentation

Knowledge of HIPAA and healthcare privacy requirements

Medical coding experience, including ICD-10 or CPT

Experience with electronic health record (EHR) systems

Knowledge of medication classes

Knowledge of laboratory reference ranges

Experience in clinical case management

Experience in utilization review

## WHAT YOU'LL DO

* Handling inbound calls, texts, and leads

ing

We want someone who can **close opportunities when they arrive and create opportunities when they don't.**



## WHO WE WANT



We're looking for people who are:



**HAPPY. HUNGRY. HUMBLE. SMART.**



And by smart, we mean **sharp as a tack.**



You communicate exceptionally well.



You listen.



You notice details.



You learn quickly.



You take ownership.



You don't need constant supervision.



You can handle rejection.



You accept coaching.



You solve problems instead of making excuses.



And you want to **win.**



If you're looking for an easy remote job where you can disappear between tasks, this isn't it.



If you're looking for an opportunity to **develop your skills, produce results, increase your income, and potentially grow into leadership**, we'd like to meet you.



## GOHIGHLEVEL + TECHNOLOGY



We use **GoHighLevel (GHL)** as our CRM.

* CRM pipelines

*

* Tasks

* Detailed notes

* Opportunity tracking

* **Extremely fast and reliable internet**

* Reliable computer

* Professional headset/microphone

* Quiet work environment

* Strong computer skills

* Excellent spoken and written English



CRM discipline and attention to detail are extremely important.



**If it isn't documented, it didn't happen.**



## COMPENSATION



We reward performance.



You'll receive:



**Hourly Base Pay**



**+ Commission on Jobs You Book**



**+ Performance Bonuses**



**+ Quarterly Bonuses**



We want high performers to earn more as they become more valuable and generate more revenue.



We're looking for people with financial goals — not people who simply want to clock hours.



## SCHEDULE



We operate **7 days per week.**



**Monday–Friday:** 8:00 AM–8:00 PM Arizona Time

You'll have a defined schedule within those hours.

We're building toward **eight figures and expansion into multiple major U.S. markets.**



As we grow, we expect opportunities to develop in:



Sales Leadership • Sales Management • Commercial Business Development • Customer Experience • Operations • Training • Market Leadership



We want long-term people.



People who take ownership.



People who become more valuable every year.



People who want to look back someday and say:



**“I was here when this company was small — and I helped build it.”**



---

**READ THIS CAREFULLY.**



We're intentionally including an application step to see who actually pays attention to instructions.

AI Advanced Editor.

An AI Advanced Editor works on our highest-leverage creative: AI-assisted video, hook development, and the ad formats we scale behind. title: Creative & Growth Operations Manager - DTC Performance
description:
Summary

We are looking for a Creative & Growth Operations Manager to build and manage the operational foundation of a fast-growing DTC beauty brand primarily serving the US market.



This role will connect the full performance growth workflow across Creative Strategists, media buyers, copywriters, video editors, designers, UGC creators, CRO specialists, funnel builders, and retention specialist — ensuring that creative assets, advertorials, landing pages, offers, and retention initiatives move smoothly from strategy and brief through production, launch, performance review, and iteration.



We are looking for someone who is highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and experienced in building scalable systems inside a fast-moving DTC or performance marketing environment.



Key Responsibilities



- Manage the end-to-end workflow across performance creative, UGC production, advertorials, listicles, landing pages, PDPs, offer tests, and retention initiatives.

- Translate creative, CRO, and retention roadmaps into clear sprint plans with owners, priorities, dependencies, timelines, and deliverables.

- Coordinate between Creative Strategists, media buyers, copywriters, editors, designers, creators, CRO specialists, funnel builders, and retention partners.

- Ensure briefs and production requirements are complete before work begins, including formats, references, deliverables, deadlines, tracking requirements, and approval ownership.

- Manage creative and funnel timelines, production capacity, feedback, revisions, QA, approvals, asset organization, and launch readiness.

- Ensure that media-buying and conversion results are documented and fed back into creative, funnel, and retention planning for the next testing cycle.

- Build and continuously improve SOPs, ClickUp/Notion boards, trackers, dashboards, naming conventions, reporting systems, and team workflows.

- Identify bottlenecks, missed handoffs, unclear ownership, and repeated rework, then proactively improve the underlying process.

- Maintain clear accountability across the team and provide concise weekly updates covering what shipped, what is in progress, what is blocked, and what requires a decision.

- Help the team increase output and speed without sacrificing strategic quality or production standards.



Requirements



- 2+ years of experience in Creative Operations, Growth Operations, Creative Project Management, or Production Management.

- Direct experience working with DTC ecommerce brands, performance marketing teams, or direct-response creative agencies.

- Experience coordinating cross-functional teams involving Creative Strategists, media buyers, copywriters, video editors, designers, creators, CRO specialists, funnel builders, or retention teams.

- Strong understanding of the performance creative lifecycle, from research and briefs through production, launch, performance analysis, iteration, and learning documentation.

- Familiarity with direct-response funnels, including advertorials, listicles, pre-landers, landing pages, PDPs, offer testing, upsells, and conversion-focused copy.

- Demonstrated experience building SOPs, production systems, capacity trackers, approval workflows, and operational processes from scratch.

- Strong project management skills across multiple SKUs, campaigns, and concurrent workstreams.

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, reliable, and proactive, with strong ownership and follow-through.

- Comfortable working directly with founders and senior functional leads while maintaining clear responsibility across the wider team.

- Proficiency with ClickUp, Notion, Asana, Slack, Google Workspace, or similar project-management and documentation tools.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Availability for substantial working-hour overlap with the Asia-based team.



Why Join Us



- Long-term opportunity with the potential to transition into a full-time contractor role.

- High ownership and direct impact on how the creative and growth organization is built.

- Work directly with the founder and senior specialists across various teams

- Opportunity to build the operating system behind a fast-growing DTC brand



How to apply



Please apply with:



- Your CV/LinkedIn and current availability



- Examples of DTC/ecommerce brands or teams you have supported



- Your expected monthly salary



- Share one real example where you personally managed a creative or growth workflow across strategy, production, launch and performance review. What was the bottleneck, what system or process did you introduce, and what improved as a result?



- What tools have you used to manage creative production and performance learnings (e.g. ClickUp, Notion, Airtable), and what was your exact responsibility within the team?

description:
AI Operations & Automation Manager



We are a U.S. immigration law firm looking for an experienced AI Operations & Automation Manager who can independently audit our current workflows, identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies, redesign and document our processes, and then personally build AI automations and AI agents to improve the way the firm operates.



This is not just an automation developer role and not just a traditional Operations Manager role. We need someone who can understand how a business actually operates first, then determine what should be improved, standardized, automated, or handled by AI.



Initial Focus



Our first priority will be auditing our case-preparation workflow from the time a client hires us through attorney review and filing.



Much of this process is currently managed by a small team, and we want greater visibility into:



how work is actually being completed

how cases are prioritized

where cases are delayed or stalled

staff responsibilities and handoffs

unnecessary manual or duplicate work

processes that currently depend on individual employee knowledge

opportunities for AI and automation



You will interview team members, observe existing workflows, map the current process, identify bottlenecks, and recommend a better future-state workflow before implementing automation.



Responsibilities

Conduct operational and workflow audits

Interview employees and independently map how work actually happens

Identify bottlenecks, duplicate work, unnecessary steps, and unclear ownership

Create current-state and future-state process maps

Develop clear SOPs and process documentation

Define responsibilities, handoffs, triggers, and escalation points

Design and personally build workflow automations

Build and deploy AI agents for appropriate business processes

Integrate AI with existing systems using APIs and webhooks

Create dashboards and reporting that improve owner visibility

Build human-in-the-loop workflows for sensitive or higher-risk tasks

Document all systems so the business is not dependent on one employee or developer

Continuously identify opportunities to improve efficiency and scalability

Required Experience



We are specifically looking for someone with hands-on experience in both operations/process improvement AND AI automation.



Strong experience with several of the following is preferred:



ChatGPT / OpenAI / OpenAI API

Claude / Anthropic API

AI agents / agentic workflows

n8n

Make

Zapier

APIs and webhooks

RAG / AI knowledge bases

AI document processing

CRM and workflow integrations

SOP creation

Process mapping

Business process improvement

Workflow redesign

Operations management

What We Are NOT Looking For



We are not looking for someone who:



only uses ChatGPT for prompting or content creation

only builds basic Zapier automations

requires us to fully design the workflow before they can build anything

only manages employees without technical automation skills



We need someone who can independently discover the process, improve the process, and then build the technology around it.



To Apply



Please answer these three questions:



Describe one business workflow you personally audited and redesigned where the process was not already clearly documented for you. How did you discover the real workflow, and what did you change?

Describe 1–2 AI agents you personally built and deployed in a real business. What did the agents do, and what tools/models did you use?

For those projects, what did you personally build versus work completed by another developer or team?



Please include links to your portfolio, GitHub, case studies, Loom videos, or examples of systems you have personally built, if available.



Schedule



This may begin as a project focused on the operational audit and redesign, with the potential to develop into a longer-term role depending on fit and results.



Experience working with U.S. professional-services businesses or law firms is a plus, but not required.

title: Virtual Receptionist VA (Remote) | Fast Hiring – 24-Hour Review
description:
**IMPORTANT: PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING**



We are currently hiring for a long-term Remote Receptionist position. Responsibilities include answering inbound calls, scheduling appointments, de-escalating complaints, and completing administrative tasks in a fast-paced environment. This is a performance-based role where all calls are recorded and regularly audited for quality assurance.



For candidates who may be a stronger fit outside of a call-handling role, we also have a few non-voice positions available, subject to availability and overall fit. If you are interested, please clearly state that you are interested in a non-voice role and submit a brief three-sentence introduction about yourself along with your portfolio or work samples.



Please note our application process: Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unable to respond individually to every applicant who is not selected. If you do not receive a response from us within 24 hours with information about the next step in the hiring process, you were not selected to move forward to the next round. We appreciate your interest and thank you for taking the time to apply.



————————————————————



**To apply:** Please copy the questions below, paste them into your reply, and answer each question thoroughly. Please answer based on your own personal experience and provide specific, real examples whenever requested. Incomplete, vague, generic, or copied responses may not be considered.



**(1)** Which city and region in the Philippines are you currently located in? Which backup solutions do you currently have in place for internet or power interruptions?



**(2)** Please submit a link to a screenshot of your internet speed and links to a few samples of your previous work output or portfolio. Please indicate what work you personally completed.



**(3)** Please submit links to two short voice recordings. Recording one should demonstrate booking an appointment from 7:00 PM to 8:00 PM with a total amount of $60. Recording two should demonstrate handling a double charge for a 90-minute massage where the client sees two $90 charges and is requesting a refund.



**(4)** Are you currently employed or engaged in any other work, business, freelance projects, or income-generating activities? If yes, please briefly describe your current commitments and typical weekly availability.



**(5)** Are you able to commit to a fixed 7-day, 6-hour work schedule during Central Standard Time (CST) hours? What is your expected hourly or monthly pay rate and earliest physical start date if hired?



**(6)** Describe three work tasks you have personally completed at least 100 times in a real job. For each task, give a specific example of when you performed the task, explain exactly what you did in your own words, identify the actual tools or systems you used, and describe the final result. Include any specific details, numbers, or challenges you remember from doing the task.



**(7)** If you were hired today, what are three specific work tasks you believe you could fully handle on your own within your first week? For each example, describe the exact task, the tools or software involved, and what successful completion would look like.



**(8)** What is the highest workload you have personally handled in a single day or in a single week? Please describe it using specific, measurable figures and briefly explain the context of that workload.



**(9)** Briefly introduce yourself and describe the qualities, experiences, work habits, or achievements you believe genuinely set you apart from other applicants for this role.

title: Project Coordinator – Industrial Construction, Racking & Automation
description:
Project Coordinator – Industrial Construction, Racking & Automation



**Remote – Philippines | Full-Time | North American Projects**



MTLI Group is looking for a highly organized, technically capable **Project Coordinator** based in the Philippines to support our growing construction, warehouse automation, racking, conveyor, material handling, and facility project portfolio across Canada and the United States.



This is not simply an administrative position.



We are looking for someone who can work directly with Project Managers, Operations, Engineering, Procurement, Site Supervisors, Vendors, Subcontractors, and Customers to help ensure projects remain organized, properly documented, on schedule, and financially controlled.



The ideal candidate has experience supporting **construction, industrial, engineering, material handling, automation, manufacturing, warehousing, or similar project environments.**



## Key Responsibilities



### Project Coordination



Manage and maintain project documentation from project award through completion.



Assist Project Managers with project startup, planning, execution, tracking, and closeout.



Maintain accurate project folders, documentation, trackers, schedules, and correspondence.



Track project milestones, deliverables, deadlines, and outstanding action items.



Follow up aggressively with internal teams, subcontractors, suppliers, and customers to ensure deliverables are completed.



Coordinate multiple projects simultaneously across Canada and the United States.



### Project Scheduling



Assist with building and maintaining project schedules and Gantt charts.



Track planned versus actual progress.



Identify upcoming deadlines, dependencies, delays, and potential schedule conflicts.



Maintain look-ahead schedules for upcoming project activities.



Coordinate project schedules with field teams, subcontractors, vendors, engineering, and customers.



Escalate potential delays to the Project Manager before they become major problems.



### Cost & Financial Tracking



Maintain project cost trackers.



Track purchase orders, subcontractor costs, labor costs, equipment, freight, materials, hotels, travel, and other project expenses.



Assist Project Managers with budget versus actual reporting.



Track committed costs and outstanding invoices.



Assist with project profitability reporting.



Help identify potential cost overruns.



Maintain accurate records for change orders and additional work.



### Change Orders & Scope Tracking



Maintain a complete change order log.



Track additional work requested by customers or discovered onsite.



Assist Project Managers with collecting supporting documentation including:



Photos



Daily reports



Labor hours



Material costs



Equipment costs



Subcontractor pricing



Customer correspondence



Ensure potential change orders are identified and documented quickly.



### Documentation & Project Controls



Maintain:



Project schedules



RFI logs



Submittal logs



Change order logs



Purchase order logs



Drawing registers



Project contact lists



Material trackers



Equipment trackers



Shipping trackers



Site documentation



Project financial trackers



Project closeout documents



Ensure current drawings and revisions are distributed to the appropriate team members.



### Material & Logistics Coordination



Track equipment and material from ordering through delivery.



Communicate with vendors regarding manufacturing and shipping status.



Maintain shipment and delivery schedules.



Coordinate freight information with project teams.



Track shortages, damaged materials, incorrect quantities, and outstanding items.



Communicate potential material delays immediately.



### Field & Workforce Coordination



Assist Operations with workforce planning and crew scheduling.



Maintain project crew lists.



Track employee and subcontractor requirements.



Verify site requirements such as:



Safety certifications



Site orientations



Travel arrangements



Hotels



Equipment requirements



PPE requirements



Customer-specific documentation



Coordinate with field supervisors regarding daily project requirements.



### Daily & Weekly Reporting



Review and organize daily field reports.



Verify manpower reporting.



Track completed work.



Organize project photos and supporting documentation.



Prepare weekly project status summaries showing:



Project progress



Schedule status



Labor status



Materials



Outstanding RFIs



Change orders



Project financial status



Major risks



Required decisions



Upcoming milestones



### Customer & Vendor Communication



Communicate professionally with customers, suppliers, engineers, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders.



Schedule project meetings.



Prepare meeting agendas when required.



Take detailed meeting notes.



Distribute meeting minutes with owners and deadlines.



Follow up until action items are completed.



### Project Closeout



Coordinate project closeout documentation including:



Punch lists



Deficiency lists



Final documentation



Customer signoffs



Warranty information



As-built drawings where applicable



Final change orders



Project financial reconciliation



Lessons learned



Customer feedback



Assist with producing an end-of-project report.



# Industries / Systems We Work With



Candidates with exposure to any of the following will be strongly preferred:



Pallet racking



Industrial shelving



Mezzanines



Conveyor systems



Material handling systems



Warehouse automation



Robotics



Distribution centres



Fulfillment centres



Manufacturing facilities



Industrial construction



Electrical installations



Mechanical installations



Facility upgrades



Equipment installation



Warehouse relocations



Rack installation or dismantling



General contracting



# Software & Technical Skills



Candidates should be comfortable using or learning:



Microsoft Excel



Microsoft Word



Microsoft Outlook



Microsoft Teams



Google Workspace



Project management software



CRM systems



Microsoft Project or similar scheduling software



Bluebeam



AutoCAD drawing review



PDF drawings



Construction drawings



Gantt charts



Cost tracking spreadsheets



Document management systems



Advanced Excel skills are strongly preferred.



You do not need to be an engineer, but you must be comfortable reading drawings, measurements, schedules, quantities, and technical project information.



# Required Experience



2+ years of Project Coordinator, Construction Coordinator, Project Administrator, Project Controls, Engineering Coordinator, or similar experience preferred.



Experience supporting North American customers is highly preferred.



Construction, engineering, industrial, manufacturing, material handling, or automation experience is strongly preferred.



Excellent written and spoken English.



Strong Excel skills.



Strong attention to detail.



Ability to manage many tasks and projects simultaneously.



Ability to follow up repeatedly until an issue is resolved.



Comfortable communicating directly with senior Project Managers and customers.



Ability to work independently in a remote environment.



# Working Hours



This position supports our Canadian and United States operations.



Candidates must be comfortable working hours that provide significant overlap with **Eastern Time North American business hours.**



Some flexibility may occasionally be required during major project deployments.



# What Success Looks Like



A strong Project Coordinator at MTLI should make the Project Manager significantly more effective.



You should always know:



What is happening on the project.



What is behind schedule.



What materials are missing.



What decisions are outstanding.



What RFIs are unanswered.



What change orders are pending.



What costs have been committed.



What invoices are outstanding.



Who is working onsite.



What needs to happen next.



Nothing important should fall through the cracks.



# Performance Expectations / KPIs



### Project Documentation Accuracy



Target: **98%+ project documentation accuracy and completeness**



### Project Tracker Accuracy



Target: **100% of assigned active projects updated weekly**



### Meeting Minutes



Target: Meeting minutes and action items distributed within **24 hours**



### Project Scheduling



Target: All major milestones, dependencies, and schedule changes accurately reflected in project trackers.



### Change Order Tracking



Target: **100% of identified additional work documented and entered into the change order tracker**



### Cost Tracking



Target: Project cost trackers updated at least weekly with known committed and actual costs.



### Daily Report Compliance



Target: **95%+ collection and organization of required daily field reports**



### Material Tracking



Target: All major material and equipment deliveries tracked with upcoming risks identified in advance.



### Action Item Closure



Target: No critical project action item left without an owner and due date.



### Project Closeout



Target: Closeout packages completed within the required project closeout timeline.



# The Type of Person We Want



Extremely organized.



Detail-oriented.



Persistent.



Comfortable following people up.



Not afraid to ask questions.



Able to identify problems before being told about them.



Strong communicator.



Calm under pressure.



Comfortable managing multiple priorities.



Commercially aware.



Interested in construction and technical projects.



Someone who takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions.



# Application Requirements



Please submit:



1. Your resume.



2. A short explanation of the types of projects you have coordinated.



3. Examples of construction, engineering, automation, manufacturing, or material handling projects you have supported.



4. The project management and scheduling software you have used.



5. Your Excel skill level from 1–10.



6. Your experience reading construction or engineering drawings.



7. Your experience tracking project budgets and costs.



8. Your experience managing RFIs, submittals, purchase orders, change orders, or project documentation.



9. Your availability to work North American Eastern Time hours.



10. Your expected monthly compensation in PHP.



# Practical Skills Test



Shortlisted applicants may be provided with a sample industrial project and asked to prepare:



A project kickoff checklist.



A basic Gantt schedule.



A project cost tracker.



A material delivery tracker.



An RFI and change order log.



A weekly project status report.



A list of risks they identify from the project information provided.



We are looking for candidates who can demonstrate how they think and organize a project, not simply candidates with the strongest resume.



# About MTLI Group



MTLI Group delivers industrial construction, material handling, warehouse infrastructure, installation, maintenance, racking, conveyor, automation, relocation, and turnkey project solutions throughout Canada and the United States.



Our projects can range from smaller facility upgrades to large, multi-site industrial and distribution centre deployments.



As we continue scaling across North America, this position will become an important part of our Project Management and Operations organization.

title: Customer Service Assistant (E-commerce)
description:

About Us:

Responsibilities:

Handle negative reviews and follow up with customers.

Ensure product and compliance-related concerns are addressed.



Requirements:

3+ years in e-commerce customer service (taking feedback/reviews from them to write on our online store).

Strong English communication skills.

Experience with customer disputes

Knowledge of product compliance and returns handling.

Reliable, problem-solver, and available during AEST hours.



To Apply: Reply 'BEST CSR ' at the top of your response and then explain in 10 points about your experience and how you can be a valuable asset to our team. Write a manual response, please, not AIs. And fill out this form. Only those who fill out the form will be screened.
